title: The Invite
description: A couple invites the neighbours over for cocktails, igniting an evening full of unexpected twists and turns, revealing deeply repressed emotions and unexplored sexuality.

title: Tony (15) (AD)
description: A 19-year-old Anthony Bourdain travels to Provincetown and stumbles into the chaotic world of a restaurant kitchen, carving out a slice of a summer that will shape the course of his life.

title: The Odyssey
description: The Odyssey (2026), Christopher Nolan’s epic adaptation of Homer’s classic, follows Greek hero Odysseus on a perilous journey home after the Trojan War, encountering gods, monsters, and treacherous seas while his family faces turmoil in Ithaca Photo Id may required for 15 certificate films

title: Kiki's Delivery Service - subbed
description: Celebrate this beloved coming-of-age story from the legendary Studio Ghibli and director Hayao Miyazaki, with this new restoration. It is…

title: The Dog Stars
description: Set in a post-apocalyptic world in which a virus has wiped out most of humanity, with survivors being terrorized by roaming scavengers called "Reapers." The protagonist is Hig, a pilot who survived the flu that killed everyone he knew, his wife included. He lives in the hangar of a small abandoned airport with his dog, his only neighbor a gun-toting ex-Marine. Hig sometimes heads off in his 1956 Cessna, where he can fish and pretend things are how they used to be. When a random transmission somehow beams through his radio, the voice ignites a hope deep inside him that a better life might exist if he flies a bit further. He risks it all. to chase a possible haven in Grand Junction.

title: LATE FAME
description: Willem Dafoe is Ed Saxberger, a postal worker whose former life as a downtown poet in late-70s New York is rediscovered by a young admirer (Donovan) and his “Enthusiasm Society,” a group of 20-somethings with a comically romanticized sense of the past. In the company of his new friends, including the mysterious and mercurial Gloria (Lee of PAST LIVES), Ed has the uncanny feeling of merging with his younger self. Directed by Kent Jones (DIANE) from a witty, razor-sharp script by Samy Burch (MAY DECEMBER), LATE FAME is a funny, lively, poignant, and occasionally haunting New York story.

title: THE RAIN PEOPLE
description: “Coppola’s fourth feature, a fascinating early road movie made entirely on location with a minimal crew and a constantly evolving script. Shirley Knight is outstanding (in a superb cast) as the pregnant woman who runs away in quest of the identity she feels she has lost as a Long Island housewife, and finds herself increasingly tangled in the snares of responsibility through her encounters with a football player left mindless by an accident (Caan) and a darkly amorous traffic cop (Duvall). Symbolism rumbles beneath the characterisations (Caan as the baby she is running from and with, Duvall as the sexuality and domination she is trying to deny) but it is never facile; and the rhythms of the road movie (leading through wonderfully bizarre locations to a resonantly melodramatic finale) confirm that Coppola’s prime talent lies in choreographing movement.” – Time Out

title: Curse of the Demon
description: A missing book in the British Museum Reading Room, a dead scholar’s papers, and a cursed strip of runic parchment gradually turn inquiry into a race for survival in Jacques Tourneur’s chilling adaptation of an M.R. James short story.

title: Late Fame
description: In Kent Jones’s marvelously witty second feature, a once-upon-a-time New York poet (Willem Dafoe) gets an ego boost when he is welcomed into the world of an emerging literary salon, but must reckon with the authenticity of his newfound circle of twentysomething admirers.

title: Big Shark with Tommy Wiseau live on stage
description: THE NEW MOVIE BY TOMMY WISEAU! PLEASE NOTE - TOMMY WISEAU WILL BE TAKING TO THE STAGE AT THE FILMS ADVERTISED TIME! Please arrive 30 mins early to collect your ticket, take your seat, grab merch and meet Tommy before the film starts! Three firefighters, George, Patrick & Tim, must save New Orleans from a gigantic shark. Can New Orleans survive? Please Note: This film contains flickering or flashing lights that may affect those with photosensitive epilepsy.

title: Hunt for the Wilderpeople (10th Anniversary)
description: Taika Waititi’s iconic film is back in 4K to celebrate its 10 year anniversary! Ricky (Julian Dennison) is a defiant young city kid who finds himself on the run with his grumpy foster uncle (Sam Neill). A national manhunt ensues and the two are forced to work together to survive.

title: Spider-Man: Brand New Day
description: A forgotten Peter Parker lives alone as a full-time Spider-Man until mounting pressure triggers a dangerous change and a powerful new enemy emerges.

title: Teenage Sex and Death at Camp Miasma
description: After years of slapdash sequels and waning fandom, the Camp Miasma slasher franchise is handed over to an enthusiastic young director…

title: Bitter Christmas (15) (AD)
description: Pedro Almodóvar is back with his unique brand of storytelling, setting the stage for the tale of a filmmaker who is a little too heavily inspired by the real lives of those around him.

title: Tony
description: A 19-year-old Anthony Bourdain travels to Provincetown and stumbles into the chaotic world of a restaurant kitchen, setting off a summer that will shape the course of his life.

title: Kiki's Delivery Service
description: Celebrate this beloved coming-of-age story from the legendary Studio Ghibli, creators of Spirited Away , and Academy Award®-winning director Hayao Miyazaki, about a resourceful young witch who uses her broom to create a delivery service, only to lose her gift of flight in a moment of self-doubt. It is a tradition for all young witches to leave their families on the night of a full moon and fly off into the wide world to learn their craft. When that night comes for Kiki, she embarks on her new journey with her sarcastic black cat, Jiji, landing the next morning in a seaside town, where her unique skills make her an instant sensation.

title: The Death of Robin Hood
description: THE DEATH OF ROBIN HOOD is a darker reimagining of the classic Robin Hood tale. Set of its time, the film sees the title character grappling with his past after a life of crime and murder; a battleworn loner who finds himself gravely injured after a battle he thought would be his last. In the hands of a mysterious woman, he is offered a chance at salvation.

title: Hundreds of Beavers
description: A slapstick epic about a frostbitten battle between Jean Kayak and diabolical beavers–hundreds of them–who stand between him and survival. In this 19th century, supernatural winter epic, a drunken applejack salesman must go from zero to hero and become the greatest fur trapper by defeating hundreds ofbeavers.

title: Samba Traore
description: Winner of the Silver Bear at the 1993 Berlinale and newly restored in 4K, the great Burkinabé writer-director Idrissa Ouédraogo’s Samba Traoré remains one of the decisive works of African cinema.

title: I Want Your Sex
description: Gregg Araki's I Want Your Sex tells the story of Elliot (Cooper Hoffman), a kind-hearted if unmotivated twentysomething whose fantasies quickly come true when he lands a job with renowned artist and provocateur Erika Tracy (Olivia Wilde). When Erika breaks down office boundaries and takes Elliot on as her sexual muse and subordinate, their sexually charged relationship makes him question his own desires, boundaries, and relationships with his uptight girlfriend (Charli XCX) and repressed roommate (Chase Sui Wonders). As the stakes heighten and power dynamics shift, the film mixes satire, romantic comedy, mystery, and murder through the colourful and edgy visual language for which Araki is best known.

title: I Want Your Sex
description: Elliot lands a job for Erika Tracy as her sexual muse.

title: Kino Polonia: IDA
description: Kino Polonia presents  IDA  dir. Pawel Pawlikowski | PL/DK | 2013  Poland, 1962. Anna, a novice nun preparing to take her vows, discovers a family secret that changes her understanding of her past. Together with her aunt, she embarks on a journey to uncover the fate of her family during and after th...

title: RED SPIRIT LAKE
description:
A young woman inherits a secluded house beside Red Spirit Lake after the murder of a relative. When her friends arrive to help her settle in, their stay is interrupted by a series of brutal killings carried out by a group of violent locals, forcing the survivors into a desperate struggle to uncover the secrets surrounding the lake and stay alive.
Blending backwoods slasher conventions with no-budget underground filmmaking, the film mixes graphic violence, occult overtones, and abrasive punk aesthetics into an intentionally raw and confrontational horror experience. Its fragmented structure and DIY style have made it a cult title within American underground cinema.
With video intro by writer/director Charles Pinion.

title: How to Divorce During the War
2026 Sundance Film Festival Short Film Tour
description: Curated from this year’s festival, this selection of six standout shorts from around the world includes Jury Award winners THE BOYS AND THE BEES (Nonfiction), CRISIS ACTOR (US Fiction) and LIVING WITHOUT A VISIONARY (Animation) in an eclectic showcase of truly independent filmmaking.
director: Arielle C. Knight, Lily Platt, Stephen P. Neary, Gabriela Ortega, Anooya Swamy, Malin Barr

title: I WANT YOUR SEX
description: A bold, provocative, and wickedly funny erotic comedy-thriller from cult filmmaker Gregg Araki (Mysterious Skin, The Doom Generation). Olivia Wilde and Cooper Hoffman lead an irresistible ensemble cast featuring Charli XCX, Chase Sui Wonders, Mason Gooding and Daveed Diggs. Following its buzzy Sunda...

title: Colony
description: Horror master Yeon Sang-ho’s ( Train to Busan ) new zombie thriller stars Gianna Jun as biology professor Se-jeong, who’s thrust into a bloody nightmare when a rapidly mutating virus is released during a biotech conference causing authorities to seal the facility. Trapped inside with no escape, Se-jeong along with a small group of survivors must fight to stay alive while the infected undergo horrific transformations. Also starring Koo Kyo-hawn.

title: Barry Lyndon
description: Stanley Kubrick’s follow-up to the foreboding A Clockwork Orange (1971) is a stately, gorgeously crafted, epic adaptation of William Makepeace Thackeray’s novel about the curious fates of an Irish rogue. Ryan O’Neal portrays Lyndon, and the film earned seven nominations, including Best Picture, Directing, and Adapted Screenplay (all for Kubrick), with Oscars going to the Art Direction, Costume Design, Adaptation Score, and John Alcott’s painterly, natural and candlelit cinematography, which remains immensely influential.

title: WRITTEN ON THE WIND
description: Alcoholism, nymphomania, impotence, and deadly jealousy fill the screen in Douglas Sirk’s Technicolor operatic tragedy, WRITTEN ON THE WIND. Mitch Wayne, played by Rock Hudson, works hard as a geologist for the Texan oil-rich degenerate Hadleys who envelope him in their maelstrom of psychosexual angst and fury.

title: First Cow
description: First Cow. 2019. USA. Directed by Kelly Reichardt. Screenplay by Reichardt, Jonathan Raymond, based on Raymond’s book. With John Magaro, Orion Lee, Toby Jones, Ewen Bremner, Scott Shepherd, Gary Farmer, Lily Gladstone. DCP. 121 min. In early-19th-century Oregon Territory, Cookie (John Magaro), a sensitive outsider in debt to brutish fur traders, and King Lu (Orion Lee), an affable, philosophizing Chinese immigrant, form a tender brotherhood amid rough surroundings. The two dream of a better future—and find a way to finance one with the arrival of the territory’s first cow, whose milk they surreptitiously turn into sweet treats to sell. Though cinematographer Christopher Blauvelt cocoons the viewer in verdant nature, moonlight, and the warmth of human connection, the very real terrors of capitalism and colonialism are never too far out of frame. In her seventh feature, Kelly Reichardt masterfully weaves these complex themes together, creating an intimate glimpse of the grand tragedy and beauty of the American experiment.

title: The Hunger
description: A lush vampire romance with sex and style to spare, much of it provided by stars Catherine Deneuve and David Bowie as a couple of posh, centuries-old nightclubbing New York bloodsuckers who, when one begins to show the first signs of aging, recruit assistance from Susan Sarandon’s geriatrics researcher, then find themselves in a very, very attractive throuple. Yes, that’s “Bela Lugosi’s Dead” artists Bauhaus in a brief cameo. “Twenty years after Belle de Jour, Saint Laurent once again dressed Catherine Deneuve, for Tony Scott’s cult 1980s tale of elegant vampires. Her shoulder pads, lipstick, and veils defined an era.” —David Campany, Creative Director, International Center of Photography Part of Dressed by Yves Saint Laurent

title: Speed Racer
description: Speed Racer is a young and brilliant racing driver. When corruption in the racing leagues costs his brother his life, Speed must team up with the police and the mysterious Racer X to bring an end to the corruption and criminal activities.

title: Yojimbo
description: Eternal icon Toshirō Mifune stars in this darkly comic and visually arresting masterpiece from the inimitable Akira Kurosawa. To rid a terror-stricken village of corruption, the wise ronin Sanjuro pits two evil clans against each other to his own advantage. Remade twice officially (which included a plagiarism lawsuit filed against Sergio Leone) with ripples of influence throughout the Western genre in both America and Italy, this exhilarating genre-twister remains one of the most influential and entertaining films of all time. Don’t miss all the samurai action you can handle on the big screen!

title: CITY LIGHTS
description: CITY LIGHTS, the most cherished film by Charlie Chaplin, is also his ultimate Little Tramp chronicle. The writer-director-star achieved new levels of grace, in both physical comedy and dramatic poignancy, with this silent tale of a lovable vagrant falling for a young blind woman who sells flowers on the street (a magical Virginia Cherrill) and mistakes him for a millionaire. Though this Depression-era smash was made after the advent of sound, Chaplin remained steadfast in his love for the expressive beauty of the pre-talkie form. The result was the epitome of his art and the crowning achievement of silent comedy.

title: MIX NYC PRESENTS: EARLY INTERIORITY: VINTAGE TRANS CINEMA
description: This program gathers rare vintage short films that open a portal to trans feminine interior life between 1967 and 1982. We meet these women in moments of quiet confidence, everyday mundanity, and enduring glamour. Through deeply intimate portraits, these films unearth buried pieces of trans history while illuminating how the world has long constricted trans women’s freedom to be. Made under a police state, these portraits mirror the experiences of trans femmes today. Each woman captured becomes a living testament to ancestral resilience and the enduring necessity of trans documentation. This program is co-curated by Thee Rose and Rosalina Michele for MIX NYC, one of the oldest queer experimental film festivals in the world. Special thanks to the Institute for Studies on Latin American Art (ISLAA); to Bradford Nordeen for providing the digital exhibition files; and to the Film-Makers' Coop for providing the 16mm prints. Nikolai Ursin BEHIND EVERY GOOD MAN (1967, 8 min, 16mm) Marguerite Paris ALL WOMEN ARE EQUAL (1972, 15 min, 16mm. Preserved by MIX NYC and the Women’s Film Preservation Fund via New York Women in Film & Television.) Joseph Horning VALERIE (1975, 16 min, 16mm-to-DCP) Manuel Herreros de Lemos & Mateo Manaure Arilla TRANS (1982, 22 min, 16mm-to-DCP) Total running time: ca. 65 min. Followed by a discussion between curators Thee Rose and Rosalina Michele, moderated by Kristen Lovell (co-director of THE STROLL).

title: Pink Palace: Fassbinder – Fox and His Friends
description: Pink Palace presents this gritty look at the seduction of a working class gay man by the bourgeois materialistic middle classes of 1970’s West Germany.  Fox and His Friends is among the director’s most personal works and the first to tackle homosexuality in a direct manner. Fassbinder himself plays ...

title: The Odyssey (15) 35mm
description: Christopher Nolan brings one of the world's most famous ancient texts to life in this mythic action epic starring Matt Damon, Anne Hathaway, Tom Holland and more, screened on glorious 35mm film.

title: Copycat
description: Jon Amiel’s polished serial-killer thriller splits its cat-and-mouse game between Sigourney Weaver’s screen-bound criminal psychologist and Holly Hunter’s dryly pragmatic cop in the field, cleverly turning research into a relay between deskwork and fieldwork.

title: De Gaulle: Resistance
description: A powerful account of Charles de Gaulle's journey during World War II, from his rise as a military leader to his emergence in French politics between 1940-1945.

title: FILIPIÑANA

title: MEGALOPOLIS
description: “MEGALOPOLIS is equal parts STAR WARS prequel and MAN WITH A MOVIE CAMERA (1929). It’s Dario Argento’s DRACULA 3D (2012) and it’s Fellini’s SATYRICON (1969). More than anything else, it’s SOUTHLAND TALES, Richard Kelly’s 2006 head-scratcher of a follow-up to DONNIE DARKO (2001), but with less of Philip K. Dick’s DNA and more of Ayn Rand’s. It exists in conversation with APOCALYPSE NOW (1979), and it ends with a revised version of the pledge of allegiance being recited by a chorus of children. It’s a challenge to discuss it without bringing up a laundry list of cinematic reference points because, in the cubist tradition, it seems to break apart and rearrange over 100 years of film history into something completely baffling and new.” – Chicago Reader

title: Franz
description: Her most ambitious work to date, acclaimed writer-director Agnieszka Holland’s fevered and funny biopic gets thrillingly close to understanding Franz Kafka by refusing to pin him down to any one interpretation.

title: I Want Your Sex

title: TWISTED ISSUES
description:
A teenage skateboarder is murdered by a gang of local punks, only to return from the grave on his skateboard to exact revenge on those responsible. As his killing spree unfolds, the story collides with live punk performances, skate culture, surreal comedy, and bursts of graphic gore, creating an increasingly chaotic portrait of late-1980s underground youth culture.
Rather than following a conventional slasher structure, the film functions as a DIY snapshot of the Gainesville, Florida punk scene, mixing horror, music, satire, and experimental collage. Its anarchic editing, homemade effects, and regional soundtrack give it the feel of a time capsule as much as a revenge film.
With video intro by writer/director Charles Pinion.

title: Matador
description: Pedro Almodóvar's 1986 erotic thriller explores the intimate relationship between pleasure and death through the convergence of bullfighting and murder. Diego is an ex-champion matador who now runs a bullfighting school. Still looking for a kick, he watches sadistic videos for sexual pleasure. Maria is a lawyer and Diego’s number one fan – she also likes to kill men with a hairpin at the point of orgasm. The pair are destined to meet.

title: The Samurai and the Prisoner
description: When Lord Murashige Araki (Masahiro Motoki) rises up against the tyrannical Nobunaga Oda (Masaki Suda), he finds himself besieged within the walls of his own castle. Isolated, he is confronted with a series of mysterious crimes that shatter the fragile order of his court, plunging the fortress into fear and suspicion. With Oda’s army closing in and a traitor hiding among his ranks, Murashige is forced into an uneasy alliance with Kanbei Kuroda (Masaki Suda), a brilliant yet dangerous strategist held prisoner in the dungeon. Helped by his wife Chiyoho (Yuriko Yoshitaka) and his most loyal generals, Murashige must uncover the truth before the castle falls. “Kurosawa has made one of his best films, a work that feels a bit like Agatha Christie, a bit like Shakespeare, and even a bit like Samurai Columbo.” – RogerEbert.com

description: Bloody and bewildering, Jane Schoenbrun brings a film-within-a-film that unpacks a meta world of queer desire, pop-cultural gaze and identity. Starring Hannah Einbinder and Gillian Anderson.

But when the latest movie’s director becomes obsessed with the mysterious, reclusive actress who played the “final girl” in the original film, a whole new kind of slasher emerges from the bottom of the lake. Warning: This film contains sequences with flashing or flickering lights that may affect individuals with photosensitivity. Viewer discretion is advised.

title: TEENAGE SEX AND DEATH AT CAMP MIASMA
description: After years of slapdash sequels and waning fandom, the Camp Miasma slasher franchise is handed over to an enthusiastic young director for resurrection. But when she visits the original's star, a now-reclusive actress shrouded in mystery, the two women fall into a blood-soaked world of desire, fear, ...

title: La La Land (10th Anniversary)
description: Mia, an aspiring actress, serves lattes to movie stars in between auditions and Sebastian, a jazz musician, scrapes by playing cocktail party gigs in dingy bars, but as success mounts they are faced with decisions that begin to fray the fragile fabric of their love affair, and the dreams they worked so hard to maintain in each other threaten to rip them apart.

title: The Dog Stars
description: Set in a post-apocalyptic world in which a virus has wiped out most of humanity, with survivors being terrorized by roaming scavengers called "Reapers." The protagonist is Hig, a pilot who survived the flu that killed everyone he knew, his wife included. He lives in the hangar of a small abandoned airport with his dog, his only neighbor a gun-toting ex-Marine. Hig sometimes heads off in his 1956 Cessna, where he can fish and pretend things are how they used to be. When a random transmission somehow beams through his radio, the voice ignites a hope deep inside him that a better life might exist if he flies a bit further. He risks it all. to chase a possible haven in Grand Junction.

title: Big Shark with Tommy Wiseau live on stage
description: THE NEW MOVIE BY TOMMY WISEAU! PLEASE NOTE - TOMMY WISEAU WILL BE TAKING TO THE STAGE AT THE FILMS ADVERTISED TIME! Please arrive 30 mins early to collect your ticket, take your seat, grab merch and meet Tommy before the film starts! Yes we know the shows are allocated seating, but if you all arrive at the advertised time we end up with a very busy foyer / bar & you won't get to your seat when the Q&A starts! ------------------------------------ From the creator of THE ROOM, join us for the return of Tommy Wiseau's BIG SHARK with TOMMY WISEAU LIVE AND IN PERSON from 3rd SEPTEMBER 2026! Three firefighters, George, Patrick & Tim, must save New Orleans from a gigantic shark. Can New Orleans survive? Please Note: This film contains flickering or flashing lights that may affect those with photosensitive epilepsy.

title: Bitter Christmas
description: Bitter Christmas tells two alternating stories, one starring Elsa, an advertising director, in 2004, during a long weekend in December. The second takes place in 2026 and stars Raúl, a screenwriter and director who is writing a script that we soon discover is the story of Elsa, her boyfriend Bonifacio, and her friends Patricia and Natalia. Mixed with fiction, Elsa is, in a way, Raúl's alter ego, who, like him, resorts to autofiction as a solution to a long period of creative drought. He looks inside himself, and he can't help but also look at the people who make up his most intimate universe: his partner and his assistant.

title: I WANT YOUR SEX
description: A bold, provocative, and wickedly funny erotic comedy-thriller from cult filmmaker Gregg Araki (Mysterious Skin, The Doom Generation). Olivia Wilde and Cooper Hoffman lead an irresistible ensemble cast featuring Charli XCX, Chase Sui Wonders, Mason Gooding and Daveed Diggs. Following its buzzy Sunda...

title: Insidious: Out of the Further
description: Gemma, a young mother raising her daughter in the house she grew up in, discovers she can travel into The Further, where she possesses an ability to bring what lives there back to the real world.

title: It Ends
description: Fri Aug 21 and Sat, Aug 22: Q&A with director Alex Ullom at 7:00 show Sun, Aug 23: Q&A with director Alex Ullom at 4:55 show A group of recent grads head out on a late night drive for grub, hoping to enjoy one final hangout before their paths diverge. Instead, they accidentally turn onto a never-ending, two lane hellscape surrounded by untold horrors and cosmic forces beyond their understanding.

title: FILIPIÑANA
description: 17-year-old Isabel navigates the opulent pavilions and lush green landscapes of Dr. Palanca’s luxury golf course as a newly-hired “tee girl.” Meticulously composed, highly stylized, and guided by precisely choreographed movement and deadpan delivery, FILIPIÑANA unfolds through the gradual accumulation of everyday encounters between staff and the wealthy clients of this secluded country club on the outskirts of Manila. When she attempts to return a lost golf club, Isabel uncovers a dark underbelly beneath the club’s pristine surfaces, in this sweltering, pastel-colored fairy tale of class division, institutional patriarchy, and invisible violence.

title: Leviticus
description: Teenage boys Naim and Ryan strike up an unexpected connection. But when their bond draws the attention of their community, a ritual is performed on them, releasing a violent entity. An entity that takes the form of its victim's truest desire.

title: Gandahar
description: An entire civilization must confront its destiny in alternative-animation pioneer René Laloux’s final feature, a cult classic of mind-bending science fiction. In a distant world, a merciless army of automata attacks Gandahar, turning its peace-loving people to stone. Hoping to discover the source of these Men of Metal, a council of matriarchs enlists the brave yet inexperienced warrior Sylvain (Pierre-Marie Escourro), who, while journeying through his planet’s outer regions, teams up with the Deformed, a race cast out from Gandahar after failed science experiments rendered them mutants. Soon, Sylvain learns that a gargantuan brain called Metamorphis (Georges Wilson) is responsible for his utopian society’s strife and—together with the beautiful Airelle (Catherine Chevallier)—travels through time to defeat him, in the process risking their lives and Gandahar’s very existence. Featuring stunningly surreal creatures and wondrously bizarre environments designed by renowned comic-book artist Caza, Gandahar is a visceral, visionary head-trip in which animation opens a gateway to the furthest reaches of the imagination.

title: Mysterious Skin
description: At the age of eight, Kansas youngsters Neil and Brian played on the same little league baseball team. Now, ten years later, the two boys couldn’t be more different. Neil is a charismatic but emotionally aloof male hustler, while Brian is a nervous introvert obsessed with the idea that he has been abducted by a UFO. When the boys’ parallel lives inevitably intersect, the pair unearth dark, repressed secrets on a harrowing and unforgettable journey of self-discovery. Director’s Statement: “I’m SO excited about the glorious 4K restoration of MYSTERIOUS SKIN! When we made this little indie 20 years ago, we barely had enough money to finish it, let alone pay for a Digital Intermediate and the bells and whistles of a larger studio film. I would never drastically alter the film which has such an amazing and passionate following around the world. However, the incredible tools made possible by modern digital technology helped us polish and enhance the picture in a way that wasn’t possible in the early 00’s. MYSTERIOUS SKIN holds a special place in my heart and I can’t wait for audiences, present and future, to experience this new definitive version of it.” Official Selection: Sundance, TIFF, Venice Film Festival Previous screenings:

title: I Want Your Sex
description: I WANT YOUR SEX tells the story of Elliot (Cooper Hoffman), a kind-hearted if unmotivated twentysomething whose fantasies quickly come true when he lands a job with renowned artist and provocateur Erika Tracy (Olivia Wilde). When Erika breaks down office boundaries and takes Elliot on as her sexual muse and subordinate, their sexually charged relationship makes him question his own desires, boundaries, and relationships with his uptight girlfriend (Charli XCX) and repressed roommate (Chase Sui Wonders). As the stakes heighten and power dynamics shift, the film mixes satire, romantic comedy, mystery, and murder through the colourful and edgy visual language for which Araki is best known.

title: MIX NYC PRESENTS: EARLY INTERIORITY: VINTAGE TRANS CINEMA (encore screening)
description: This program gathers rare vintage short films that open a portal to trans feminine interior life between 1967 and 1982. We meet these women in moments of quiet confidence, everyday mundanity, and enduring glamour. Through deeply intimate portraits, these films unearth buried pieces of trans history while illuminating how the world has long constricted trans women’s freedom to be. Made under a police state, these portraits mirror the experiences of trans femmes today. Each woman captured becomes a living testament to ancestral resilience and the enduring necessity of trans documentation. This program is co-curated by Thee Rose and Rosalina Michele for MIX NYC, one of the oldest queer experimental film festivals in the world. Special thanks to the Institute for Studies on Latin American Art (ISLAA); to Bradford Nordeen for providing the digital exhibition files; and to the Film-Makers' Coop for providing the 16mm prints. Nikolai Ursin BEHIND EVERY GOOD MAN (1967, 8 min, 16mm) Marguerite Paris ALL WOMEN ARE EQUAL (1972, 15 min, 16mm. Preserved by MIX NYC and the Women’s Film Preservation Fund via New York Women in Film & Television.) Joseph Horning VALERIE (1975, 16 min, 16mm-to-DCP) Manuel Herreros de Lemos & Mateo Manaure Arilla TRANS (1982, 22 min, 16mm-to-DCP) Total running time: ca. 65 min. Followed by a discussion between curators Thee Rose and Rosalina Michele, moderated by Kristen Lovell (co-director of THE STROLL).

title: Collateral
description: Los Angeles cabbie Max Durocher (Jamie Foxx) is in for the toughest fare of his working life when he picks up one Vincent (Tom Cruise, natty in charcoal gray sharkskin suit), a jazz enthusiast and professional hitman who quite firmly insists that his driver accompany him on his evening’s rounds, leaving a trail of bodies in his wake. Shooting LA exteriors after dark with a then-state-of-the-art Sony F-900 digital camera, Mann gave his film a wholly distinctive texture—combining expressionistic smear with a new ability to pick up detail that would be lost on celluloid—and initiated a quiet revolution in low-light cinematography. A drum-tight character-based thriller, and the only film in which you can see Tom Cruise saying: “Yo, homie… Is that my briefcase?” Part of This Night Has Opened My Eyes

title: The Others
description: Having enjoyed a palpable international hit with his Abre Los Ojos—picked up for an American remake, under the title Vanilla Sky, by Tom Cruise—Amenábar made his English-language debut with The Others, a dolorous, deftly directed Old Dark House chiller set in the immediate aftermath of World War II, about a devoutly religious Englishwoman (Nicole Kidman, superb) living in a remote home in the Channel Island with her two young, severely photosensitive children and the strange goings-on that begin shortly after she takes on a trio of new servants. “Elegant… Creates more tension from atmosphere alone than most other horror films do from vats full of fake blood.” —The Times of London Part of In Her Shadow

title: Colony
description: Horror master Yeon Sang-ho’s ( Train to Busan ) new zombie thriller stars Gianna Jun as biology professor Se-jeong, who’s thrust into a bloody nightmare when a rapidly mutating virus is released during a biotech conference causing authorities to seal the facility. Trapped inside with no escape, Se-jeong along with a small group of survivors must fight to stay alive while the infected undergo horrific transformations. Also starring Koo Kyo-hawn.

title: DER FAN
description: Simone (the magnetic Désirée Nosbusch) is a teenage runaway who is obsessed with the pop singer known as “R.” Soon, that obsession takes over her life. When “R” uses Simone with machine-like coldness, she plots her revenge with an unholy ceremony that’s equally romantic and horrifying. Fueled by a killer minimalist synth soundtrack from Rheingold and a gorgeous design aesthetic, DER FAN is a subversive and electric shocker that goes harder than you’d ever expect it to go.

title: The Invite             / Bob & Carol & Ted & Alice
description: Joe and Angela’s marriage is on thin ice. When they invite their enigmatic upstairs neighbors for a dinner party, the night spirals into unexpected places. Have they reignited the spark or lit the match that burns it all down? (A24)

title: How to Divorce During the War
Wild Inside
description: Join educator and wildlife rehabilitator Suzanne Highland for a post screening Birdwatching Tour of the West Village after the 4pm screenings on 8/1 and 8/2! the path runs from the IFC to Hudson River Park with a pit stop in Washington Square Park. Bring binoculars if you have them! About WILD INSIDE: A Eurasian Eagle-Owl named Flaco escapes from the Central Park Zoo and sets off on a magical odyssey through the island of Manhattan. Flaco overcomes his years of captivity and lack of survival skills to answer the call of the wild – and discovers he was wild inside all along.

But when the latest movie’s director becomes obsessed with the mysterious, reclusive actress who played the “final girl” in the original film, a whole new kind of slasher emerges from the bottom of the lake. Warning: This film contains sequences with flashing or flickering lights that may affect individuals with photosensitivity. Viewer discretion is advised.

title: 2026 Sundance Film Festival Short Film Tour
description: Curated from this year’s festival, this selection of six standout shorts from around the world includes Jury Award winners THE BOYS AND THE BEES (Nonfiction), CRISIS ACTOR (US Fiction) and LIVING WITHOUT A VISIONARY (Animation) in an eclectic showcase of truly independent filmmaking.
director: Arielle C. Knight, Lily Platt, Stephen P. Neary, Gabriela Ortega, Anooya Swamy, Malin Barr

title: Leviticus
description: From the producers of Talk To Me and The Babadook, LEVITICUS is the striking feature debut from writer-director Adrian Chiarella, telling the story of two teenage boys whose forbidden relationship unleashes a terrifying supernatural entity that takes the form of the person they desire most - each other. Blending nerve-shredding suspense with an emotionally powerful love story, the film delivers an unforgettable theatrical experience that lingers long after the credits roll.

title: La Haine
description: Hatred breeds hatred... 24 hours in the lives of three young men in the French suburbs the day after a violent riot.

title: Marketa Lazarova
description: Frequently hailed as the greatest Czech film ever made, František Vláčil’s staggering medieval epic, shot in stark widescreen black and white, plunges into the blood-soaked borderlands of 13th-century Bohemia amid the uneasy transition from paganism to Christianity.

title: Matador
description: Pedro Almodóvar's 1986 erotic thriller explores the intimate relationship between pleasure and death through the convergence of bullfighting and murder. Diego is an ex-champion matador who now runs a bullfighting school. Still looking for a kick, he watches sadistic videos for sexual pleasure. Maria is a lawyer and Diego’s number one fan – she also likes to kill men with a hairpin at the point of orgasm. The pair are destined to meet.

title: The Terminator
description: Disguised as a human, a cyborg assassin known as a Terminator (Arnold Schwarzenegger) travels from 2029 to 1984 to kill Sarah Connor (Linda Hamilton). Sent to protect Sarah is Kyle Reese (Michael Biehn), who divulges the coming of Skynet, an artificial intelligence system that will spark a nuclear holocaust. Sarah is targeted because Skynet knows that her unborn son will lead the fight against them. With the virtually unstoppable Terminator in hot pursuit, she and Kyle attempt to escape. 40th Anniversary restoration from a 4K film scan of the 35mm negative and a new Dolby Atmos mix with final sound and picture approved by director James Cameron. Presented by Park Circus with thanks to MGM. Post House: Park Road Post, Colourist: Tashi Trieu, Sound Mixer for Atmos: Mike Hedges

title: GARDENS OF STONE
description: “Tells the stories of several relationships at this outpost far behind the front lines. The film introduces the kid (D. B. Sweeney), his immediate superior (James Caan) and the sergeant above him (James Earl Jones). And then there is the girl the kid would like to marry (Mary Stuart Masterson), and there is Caan’s new girlfriend (Anjelica Huston), who works for the Washington Post and considers the Vietnam War to be genocide.” – Roger Ebert

title: Late Fame
description: In Kent Jones’s marvelously witty second feature, a once-upon-a-time New York poet (Willem Dafoe) gets an ego boost when he is welcomed into the world of an emerging literary salon, but must reckon with the authenticity of his newfound circle of twentysomething admirers.

title: Onslaught
description: When a rogue squad of genetically engineered super soldiers break loose in the desert, a badass Army sniper must unleash hell to protect her young daughter.

title: CLEAN, SHAVEN
description: Lodge Kerrigan began his succession of utterly unique, visually and aurally dazzling character studies with the raw, ravaging CLEAN, SHAVEN. A compelling headfirst dive into the mindscape of a schizophrenic (played by the remarkable Peter Greene) as he tries to track down his daughter after he is released from an institution, Kerrigan’s film brilliantly uses sound and image to lead audiences into a terrifying subjectivity. No one is left unscathed.

title: LATE FAME
description: Willem Dafoe is Ed Saxberger, a postal worker whose former life as a downtown poet in late-70s New York is rediscovered by a young admirer (Donovan) and his “Enthusiasm Society,” a group of 20-somethings with a comically romanticized sense of the past. In the company of his new friends, including the mysterious and mercurial Gloria (Lee of PAST LIVES), Ed has the uncanny feeling of merging with his younger self. Directed by Kent Jones (DIANE) from a witty, razor-sharp script by Samy Burch (MAY DECEMBER), LATE FAME is a funny, lively, poignant, and occasionally haunting New York story.

title: Kiki's Delivery Service
description: Celebrate this beloved coming-of-age story from the legendary Studio Ghibli, creators of Spirited Away , and Academy Award®-winning director Hayao Miyazaki, about a resourceful young witch who uses her broom to create a delivery service, only to lose her gift of flight in a moment of self-doubt. It is a tradition for all young witches to leave their families on the night of a full moon and fly off into the wide world to learn their craft. When that night comes for Kiki, she embarks on her new journey with her sarcastic black cat, Jiji, landing the next morning in a seaside town, where her unique skills make her an instant sensation.

title: Chronovisor
description: Inspired by the true story of a “fake” invention, Kevin Walker and Jack Auen’s Chronovisor follows a Columbia professor deep into a Borgesian labyrinth of textual clues pointing to a time-travel device rumored to have been suppressed by the Vatican.

title: The Sun Never Sets
description: Sat, Aug 22 at 2:30pm: Sneak Preview + Q&A with stars Dakota Fanning and Cory Michael Smith Free-spirited Wendy (Dakota Fanning) is at a crossroads in her relationship with older divorced dad Jack (Jake Johnson, New Girl ) that is only further complicated when an old flame (Cory Michael Smith, Sentimental Value ) re-enters her life. Set in perpetually sunny summertime Anchorage and featuring a career-best performance by Fanning, THE SUN NEVER SETS is a funny and endearing return to form for mumblecore auteur Joe Swanberg. Regular engagement begins Fri, Sep 4. Showtimes to be announced. Official selection: SXSW “Marks a confident return for Swanberg, bolstered by a stellar performance from Fanning and a thoughtful, often painful exploration of love, growth, and the realization that fulfillment doesn’t always come from another person.” – Film Inquiry

title: Late Fame
description: The great Willem Dafoe lends his delicate gravitas to the role of Ed Saxberger, a forgotten New York poet who works in the post office. After an eager and flattering young admirer (Edmund Donovan) appears on his doorstep, Saxberger is beckoned into a coterie of twenty-something admirers who anoint him as a rediscovered genius. Intoxicated by the attention — and by the alluring presence of Gloria, the group’s“ tragic heroine” (a sinuous, Kurt Weill– crooning Greta Lee) — Saxberger gradually reckons with the authenticity of his newfound poetic circle. This thoughtful, witty second feature from Kent Jones (DIANE), working from a sly and hugely entertaining script by Oscar - nominated screenwriter Samy Burch (MAYDECEMBER), is a wistful yet unromantic look at a lost idea of downtown New York.

title: Trainspotting
description: Choose life. Choose a job. Choose a starter home. Choose dental insurance, leisure wear and matching luggage. Choose your future. But why would anyone want to do a thing like that? Director Danny Boyle’s electrifying look at the exhilarating highs and terrifying lows of the Edinburgh drug scene is daringly original, energetically stylish, and brutally funny, with a stellar ensemble including Ewan McGregor, Jonny Lee Miller, and Robert Carlyle, plus one of the most iconic soundtracks of the ‘90s.

title: Heathers
description: NEW 4K RESTORATION “What is your damage, Heather?” Cynical, surreal and viciously funny, this dark high school comedy remains one of the most influential teen movies ever. Iconic performances from 80s luminaries Winona Ryder, Shannen Doherty and Christian Slater, and a cornucopia of gleefully nasty putdowns ( “Lick it up baby. Lick. It. Up.” ) mask an earnest plea for empathy and kindess at the center of HEATHERS’ black heart.

title: The Dream Songs + Q&A
description: The screening will be followed by an online Q&A with the director Cho Hyun-chul, moderated by Dr. Hyunseon Lee (Professorial Research Associate at SOAS), interpreted…

title: Monkey Business
description: Dr. Barnaby Fulton (Cary Grant) is a scatterbrained chemist working to create an elixir of youth. When one of his chimpanzees, Esther, breaks loose, she mixes chemicals in Barnaby’s lab, dumping the concoction into the office’s water cooler. The formula generates the rejuvenation effect Barnaby has been seeking — along with more chaotic side effects in some cases. Monkey Business allowed Monroe, who co-stars as Lois Laurel, to showcase her brilliant timing, further solidifying her reputation as a comedic actress.
director: Howard Hawks PRODUCED BY: Sol C. Siegel

title: In The Mood For Love
description: In 1962 Hong Kong, neighbors Su Li-zhen (Mrs. Chan) and Chow Mo-wan (Mr. Chow) discover their spouses are having an affair. As they spend time together, they develop feelings for each other, but their relationship remains chaste and unspoken, reflecting societal constraints and their own moral compass.

title: HEARTS OF DARKNESS: A FILMMAKER’S APOCALYPSE
description: In the late 1970s, director Francis Ford Coppola, accompanied by his family and cast and crew, travelled to the Philippines to begin work on what would become APOCALYPSE NOW. But it soon became one of the most notorious shoots in cinema history, spiraling into a hellish, life-threatening nightmare. Chronicling the drama was Coppola’s wife, the late Eleanor Coppola, who shot extensive behind-the-scenes footage of the shoot in 16mm, and recorded audio interviews with her husband and others involved in the movie’s making. In the early ’90s, Eleanor turned her 16mm footage and audio interviews over to filmmakers George Hickenlooper and Fax Bahr, who then interwove it with new interviews with the movie’s cast members (including Martin Sheen and Dennis Hopper) and observers (like George Lucas). After a year of editing, the new documentary debuted at the Cannes Film Festival. It had its New York theatrical premiere at Film Forum. Says James Mockoski, Film Archivist and Restoration Supervisor at American Zoetrope, “For the past 30 years, Eleanor’s 16mm behind-the-scenes footage has been three to four generations removed from the original elements. For this new release and restoration of the documentary, Francis decided to scan the original sources in 4K. The extensive excerpts from the feature are now presented in their original 2.39:1 aspect ratio, rather than being letterboxed into a 4x3 frame.”

title: Terminator 2 : Judgment Day
description: In this sequel set eleven years after "The Terminator," young John Connor (Edward Furlong), the key to civilization's victory over a future robot uprising, is the target of the shape-shifting T-1000 (Robert Patrick), a Terminator sent from the future to kill him. Another Terminator, the revamped T-800 (Arnold Schwarzenegger), has been sent back to protect the boy. As John and his mother (Linda Hamilton) go on the run with the T-800, the boy forms an unexpected bond with the robot.

title: The Samurai and the Prisoner
description: Kiyoshi Kurosawa’s stately, meticulously composed period drama, set in 16th-century Japan, is a tense and metaphysical whodunit with the director’s characteristic philosophical overtones.

title: The Death of Robin Hood
description: THE DEATH OF ROBIN HOOD is a darker reimagining of the classic Robin Hood tale. Set of its time, the film sees the title character grappling with his past after a life of crime and murder; a battleworn loner who finds himself gravely injured after a battle he thought would be his last. In the hands of a mysterious woman, he is offered a chance at salvation.

title: The Incomer
description: On an Orkney isle, siblings Isla and Sandy hunt birds and talk to mythical beings while fighting off outsiders. Their lives change when Daniel, an awkward official, arrives to relocate them.

title: LATE FAME
description: Willem Dafoe is Ed Saxberger, a postal worker whose former life as a downtown poet in late-70s New York is rediscovered by a young admirer (Donovan) and his “Enthusiasm Society,” a group of 20-somethings with a comically romanticized sense of the past. Directed by Kent Jones (DIANE) from a witty, razor-sharp script by Samy Burch (MAY DECEMBER), LATE FAME is a funny, lively, poignant, and occasionally haunting New York story.

title: The Samurai and the Prisoner
description: Join us in the microcinema for Kiyoshi Kurosawa’s ponderous and philosophical samurai epic The Samurai and the Prisoner. When Lord Murashige rises up against the tyrannical Oda, he finds himself besieged within the walls of his own castle. Isolated, he is confronted with a series of mysterious crimes that shatter the fragile order of his court, plunging the fortress into fear and suspicion. With Oda’s army closing in and a traitor hiding among his ranks, Murashige is forced into an uneasy alliance with Kanbei, a brilliant and dangerous strategist held prisoner in the dungeon, as he must outwit his enemies and uncover the truth before time runs out.

title: Marketa Lazarova

title: Sherman's March
description: Sherman’s March , winner of the Grand Jury Prize for Best Documentary at Sundance in 1987, is Ross McElwee’s monumental documentary which has been officially listed by the International Documentary Association as one of the top 20 documentary films of all time. Intending to make a film about General Sherman’s 1864 March to the Sea, Ross McElwee gets sidetracked. Affected by a recent breakup, he slows his progress through the American South to spend time with a succession of women and explore the possibility of romantic fulfilment in the nuclear age.

title: The Samurai and the Prisoner
description: When Lord Murashige Araki (Masahiro Motoki) rises up against the tyrannical Nobunaga Oda (Masaki Suda), he finds himself besieged within the walls of his own castle. Isolated, he is confronted with a series of mysterious crimes that shatter the fragile order of his court, plunging the fortress into fear and suspicion. With Oda’s army closing in and a traitor hiding among his ranks, Murashige is forced into an uneasy alliance with Kanbei Kuroda (Masaki Suda), a brilliant yet dangerous strategist held prisoner in the dungeon. Helped by his wife Chiyoho (Yuriko Yoshitaka) and his most loyal generals, Murashige must uncover the truth before the castle falls. “Kurosawa has made one of his best films, a work that feels a bit like Agatha Christie, a bit like Shakespeare, and even a bit like Samurai Columbo.” – RogerEbert.com

title: Le Havre
description: Le Havre. 2011. Finland/France/Germany. Written and directed by Aki Kaurismäki. With André Wilms, Kati Outinen, Jean-Pierre Darroussin, Blondin Miguel. DCP. In French; English subtitles. 93 min. Inspired by French poetic realism of the 1930s, Aki Kaurismäki’s Le Havre takes us to the titular port city, where we meet Marcel Marx, an elderly shoeshiner and struggling writer named after a famous revolutionary socialist, and his wife Arletty, whose name pays tribute to the star of Marcel Carné’s Hôtel du Nord (1938), Le jour se lève (1939), and Les Enfants du Paradis (1945). When Marx crosses paths with an underage, undocumented immigrant hiding from police, the power of human solidarity, as often seen in Kaurismäki’s cinema, offers a glimmer of hope and a chance for resistance in a world that’s often too brutal to be reckoned with.

title: I Want Your Sex
description: Gregg Araki's I Want Your Sex tells the story of Elliot (Cooper Hoffman), a kind-hearted if unmotivated twentysomething whose fantasies quickly come true when he lands a job with renowned artist and provocateur Erika Tracy (Olivia Wilde). When Erika breaks down office boundaries and takes Elliot on as her sexual muse and subordinate, their sexually charged relationship makes him question his own desires, boundaries, and relationships with his uptight girlfriend (Charli XCX) and repressed roommate (Chase Sui Wonders). As the stakes heighten and power dynamics shift, the film mixes satire, romantic comedy, mystery, and murder through the colourful and edgy visual language for which Araki is best known.

title: FILIPIÑANA
description: 17-year-old Isabel navigates the opulent pavilions and lush green landscapes of Dr. Palanca’s luxury golf course as a newly-hired “tee girl.” Meticulously composed, highly stylized, and guided by precisely choreographed movement and deadpan delivery, FILIPIÑANA unfolds through the gradual accumulation of everyday encounters between staff and the wealthy clients of this secluded country club on the outskirts of Manila. When she attempts to return a lost golf club, Isabel uncovers a dark underbelly beneath the club’s pristine surfaces, in this sweltering, pastel-colored fairy tale of class division, institutional patriarchy, and invisible violence.

title: APOCALYPSE NOW: FINAL CUT
description: “Starts with what proves to be a nightmare: a stand of pale green palm trees, ominous air-beating chops, the fleeting blurs of attack helicopters, a sudden rush of flame engulfing the trees as, in magically perfect rhythm, Jim Morrison’s high, thin voice croons, ‘This is the end...’ Then the dreamer of this recurring vision appears mingled with his own demonic images, in a Saigon hotel room during the Vietnam war, drunk, stunned, virtually deranged—an American captain named Benjamin Willard (Martin Sheen). Soon afterwards, his superiors send him upriver to Cambodia on a secret mission to find and kill a Green Beret colonel, Walter Kurtz (Marlon Brando), who is rumoured to be running amok there with a private army of Montagnard tribesmen and renegade Americans.” – Sight and Sound

title: Barbara Hammer: Love Is Where You Find It
description: The erotic unfurls as a vital force connecting self, lover, and collective. Barbara Hammer left behind a monumental body of work unified in its fiercely political perspective and bold exploration of lesbian life. Her earliest short films materialized from the ashes of postwar American life, as long-established virtues of womanhood were being rejected and a new vision was beginning to form. As Hammer put it in her own memoir: “The 70s were a glorious time of feminist ideals and lesbian bed-hopping.” These works spotlight Hammer’s sustained investment in collective queer worldmaking, mobilizing eroticism as a social force inseparable from emergent forms of lesbian visibility and activist formation. Images courtesy of the Estate of Barbara Hammer, New York and Electronic Arts Intermix (EAI), New York.

title: The Incomer
description: On an Orkney isle, siblings Isla and Sandy hunt birds and talk to mythical beings while fighting off outsiders. Their lives change when Daniel, an awkward official, arrives to relocate them.

title: The Death of Robin Hood
description: THE DEATH OF ROBIN HOOD is a darker reimagining of the classic Robin Hood tale. title: LATE FAME
description: Willem Dafoe is Ed Saxberger, a postal worker whose former life as a downtown poet in late-70s New York is rediscovered by a young admirer (Donovan) and his “Enthusiasm Society,” a group of 20-somethings with a comically romanticized sense of the past. In the company of his new friends, including the mysterious and mercurial Gloria (Lee of PAST LIVES), Ed has the uncanny feeling of merging with his younger self. Directed by Kent Jones (DIANE) from a witty, razor-sharp script by Samy Burch (MAY DECEMBER), LATE FAME is a funny, lively, poignant, and occasionally haunting New York story.

After an eager and flattering young admirer appears on his doorstep, Saxberger is beckoned into a coterie of twentysomething admirers who anoint him as a rediscovered genius. Intoxicated by the attention — and by the alluring presence of Gloria, the group’s “tragic heroine” — Saxberger gradually reckons with the authenticity of his newfound poetic circle. Kent Jones's thoughtful, witty film is a wistful yet unromantic look at a lost idea of downtown New York.

title: ELEVATOR GIRLS IN BONDAGE + MYSTERY SHORT
description:
The underpaid female staff of a rundown San Francisco hotel discover the writings of Karl Marx and begin organising a revolt against their exploitative employers. Led by elevator operator Maxine, the workers fight back against low wages, poor conditions, and the abusive behaviour of the hotel’s management in this anarchic underground comedy.
Created by members of the legendary San Francisco drag and performance collective The Cockettes, Michael Kalmen’s film is a surreal mixture of camp, queer underground cinema, political satire, and sexploitation. Its deliberately chaotic style, gender-bending performances, and Marxist-inspired rebellion make it a unique artefact of the early 1970s counterculture scene.

title: WHAT GODMILOW TAUGHT
description: FILMMAKER IN PERSON! In 2012, Jill Godmilow wrote to Mireia Sallarès, moved by the film she had made in Mexico about women’s orgasms. For Godmilow, who offered to help distribute the film in the U.S., LAS MUERTES CHIQUITAS (THE LITTLE DEATHS) is not a documentary about a problem of Mexican women, it is a film about orgasms as a political issue that affects everyone and raises the question of who can take responsibility for it by speaking out. How to take responsibility for our problems, how to take charge of them by making political films, was the concern that had led Godmilow to engage years earlier with Harun Farocki’s documentary INEXTINGUISHABLE FIRE, which showed how napalm production during the Vietnam War effectively exempted its makers from any responsibility for it. The fact that Farocki’s film had not been seen in the U.S. and that the problem it raised had not gone away, Godmilow decided to recreate it, in order to involve herself in the problem and put it back into circulation. As a statement about what it means today to be an author, and taking account of this complexity by broadening and politicizing the chain of authorship, she titled her replica WHAT FAROCKI TAUGHT. The present film, WHAT GODMILOW TAUGHT (2014), is a film conversation in which Mireia Sallarès captures Jill Godmilow’s commitment to a political life. Sallarès’s film engages with an artistic practice in which having an idea entails a responsibility, and in which grappling with a political problem requires collaborating with others to make useful films. Followed by: Jill Godmilow ECSTATIC ORGASM 7.5-min excerpt from an unfinished film, digital Total running time: ca. 60 min.

title: Gandahar
description: An entire civilization must confront its destiny in alternative-animation pioneer René Laloux’s final feature, a cult classic of mind-bending science fiction. In a distant world, a merciless army of automata attacks Gandahar, turning its peace-loving people to stone. Hoping to discover the source of these Men of Metal, a council of matriarchs enlists the brave yet inexperienced warrior Sylvain (Pierre-Marie Escourro), who, while journeying through his planet’s outer regions, teams up with the Deformed, a race cast out from Gandahar after failed science experiments rendered them mutants. Soon, Sylvain learns that a gargantuan brain called Metamorphis (Georges Wilson) is responsible for his utopian society’s strife and—together with the beautiful Airelle (Catherine Chevallier)—travels through time to defeat him, in the process risking their lives and Gandahar’s very existence. Featuring stunningly surreal creatures and wondrously bizarre environments designed by renowned comic-book artist Caza, Gandahar is a visceral, visionary head-trip in which animation opens a gateway to the furthest reaches of the imagination.

title: HUNT FOR THE WILDERPEOPLE
description: Nature just got gangster! Young actor Julian Dennison gives a masterful Oscar-worthy performance in Taika Waititi’s hilarious and enormously entertaining magical-realism backwoods saga HUNT FOR THE WILDERPEOPLE. Raised on hip-hop and foster care, defiant delinquent Ricky (Dennison) gets a fresh start in the New Zealand countryside with the loving Aunt Bella, the ornery Uncle Hec and dog Tupac. When a tragedy strikes that threatens to ship Ricky to another home, both he and Hec go on the run in the bush. Upon a national manhunt, the outlaws must face their options: go out in a blaze of glory or overcome their differences and survive as a family. Triumphant, touching, surreal and just about perfect.

description: Mutts. 2019. Canada. Directed by Halima Ouardiri. DCP. 18 min. Man Push Cart. 2005. USA. Written and directed by Ramin Bahrani. With Ahmad Razvi, Leticia Dolera, Charles Daniel Sandoval. 35mm. 87 min. Inspired by lead actor Ahmad Razvi’s life story, Ramin Bahrani’s Man Push Cart offers a melancholic look at post-9/11 New York from the perspective of a Pakistani immigrant—a former rock star in his native country, now a widower estranged from his son in Pakistan—as he struggles to make a living selling coffee and bagels, dragging a heavy cart through the cold, impersonal streets of Midtown Manhattan. Two decades later, Bahrani’s celebrated debut film remains a subtle look at the lives of those pushed to the margins of the American dream in a city marked by a lack of human connection. In Mutts, Halima Ouardiri films a large sanctuary in Morocco, filled with hundreds of stray dogs, and uses it as a metaphor for the struggles of refugees and life in poverty and confinement.

title: Off-Circuit: UK PREMIERE Pin de Fartie + Q&A
description: The latest production from boundlessly imaginative Argentine collective El Pampero Cine sees successive pairs of characters bid farewell: a mother and her son, a caretaker and her charge, two actors endlessly rehearsing a scene that will never be performed. A playful spin on theatrical adaptation, Alejo Moguillansky's new film is a delightfully imaginative take on Samuel Beckett's Fin de Partie , punctuated by music, tennis, and another exceptional turn by Laura Paredes. The UK Premiere screening on the 4 September will be followed by an in-person Q&A with Alejo Moguillansky.

(2001). title: WHEN HARRY MET SALLY
description: Harry (Billy Crystal) and Sally (Meg Ryan) meet in college and spend years debating whether it’s possible for men and women to be friends – all the while falling in love without realizing it. Nora Ephron’s landmark screenplay is filled with quotable lines and sharp insights, and costars Bruno Kirby and Carrie Fisher lend hilarious support. One of the definitive romantic comedies of the ’80s.

When she attempts to return a lost golf club, Isabel uncovers a dark underbelly beneath the club’s pristine surfaces, in this sweltering, pastel-colored fairy tale of class division, institutional patriarchy, and invisible violence.

title: Late Fame
description: In Kent Jones’s marvelously witty second feature, a once-upon-a-time New York poet (Willem Dafoe) gets an ego boost when he is welcomed into the world of an emerging literary salon, but must reckon with the authenticity of his newfound circle of twentysomething admirers.

title: The Incomer
description: On an Orkney isle, siblings Isla and Sandy hunt birds and talk to mythical beings while fighting off outsiders. Their lives change when Daniel, an awkward official, arrives to relocate them.

title: Tony (15) (AD)
description: A 19-year-old Anthony Bourdain travels to Provincetown and stumbles into the chaotic world of a restaurant kitchen, carving out a slice of a summer that will shape the course of his life.

title: BRAM STOKER'S DRACULA
description: “The film begins, as it should, with the tragic story of Vlad the Impaler, who went off to fight the Crusades and returned to find that his beloved wife, hearing he was dead, had killed herself. Coppola’s plot, from a screenplay by James V. Hart, exists precisely between London, where this modern age is just dawning, and Transylvania, which still sleeps unhealthily in the past. We meet a young attorney (Keanu Reeves) who has been asked to journey out to Dracula’s castle to arrange certain real estate transactions. Reeves’ carriage, driven by a man whose hands are claws, hurtles at the edges of precipices until he is finally discharged in the darkness to be met and taken to Dracula’s castle. There, everything is more or less as we expect it, only much more so. Count Dracula (Gary Oldman) waits here as he has for centuries for the return of his dead bride, and when he sees a photograph of Reeves’ fiancee, Mina Murray (Winona Ryder), he knows his wait has been rewarded at last. She lives again.” – Roger Ebert

title: A Free Woman
description: On the cusp of marriage, Liana becomes convinced she shouldn't live a life in service of a man. Instead, she leaves for Amalfi, where she embarks on an affair. From there she makes for Paris, but each new adventure is compromised by some kind of emotional constraint, culminating in a final act of tragedy. Vittorio Cottafavi's remarkably modern exploration of female autonomy exhibits the melodramatic finesse of Douglas Sirk with a style reminiscent of Max Ophuls. A Free Woman has been newly restored by Radiance.

title: TEENAGE SEX AND DEATH AT CAMP MIASMA
description: After years of slapdash sequels and waning fandom, the Camp Miasma slasher franchise is handed over to an enthusiastic young director for resurrection. But when she visits the original's star, a now-reclusive actress shrouded in mystery, the two women fall into a blood-soaked world of desire, fear, ...

title: WHAT FAROCKI TAUGHT + SCUM MANIFESTO
description: Jill Godmilow WHAT FAROCKI TAUGHT 1997, 30 min, 16mm. Made in collaboration with Gloria Jean Masciarotte & Ted Mandell. WHAT FAROCKI TAUGHT is literally and stubbornly a remake – that is, a perfect replica in color and in English, of Harun Farocki’s black-and-white, 1969 German language film, INEXTINGUISHABLE FIRE. Taking as its subject the political and formal strategies of Farocki’s film about the development of Napalm B by Dow Chemical during the Vietnam War, Godmilow’s unabashedly perfect copy reopens Walter Benjamin’s discussion of art in the age of mechanical reproduction. WHAT FAROCKI TAUGHT thus becomes an agit-prop challenge to the cinéma vérité documentary’s representation of information, history, politics, and “real” human experience. Because Farocki’s film was not in distribution in the U.S. at the time, WHAT FAROCKI TAUGHT was conceived as a gesture of film distribution – taking this small, film footnote to a war, a barnacle stuck on the side of the moth-balled vessel of Vietnam, flicking it forward past the recent, more sophisticated, and successful technologies of Panama and the Persian Gulf, to see if the “ping” of recognition and the radical potential of the documentary film project could be revived. Jill Godmilow SCUM MANIFESTO 2016, 27 min, digital. Made in collaboration with Joanna Krakowska & Magda Mosiewicz. When Sherry Millner and Ernest Larsen, the producers of the Facets DVD compilation “Disruptive Film”, couldn’t clear the rights to Delphine Seyrig and Carole Roussopoulos’s 1976 French film, SCUM MANIFESTO, they contacted Jill Godmilow, Queen of Replicas (see WHAT FAROCKI TAUGHT), who decided to produce a perfect Polish copy of this landmark film about the 1967 feminist manifesto – this time with Polish performers and current Polish newsreel of goings-on in the newly super-nationalist Polish state. Exactly as in the 1976 French film, the Poles translate then type up, phrase-by-phrase, Valerie Solanas’s still outrageous and profoundly useful 1967 text, which begins, “Life in this society being, at best, an utter bore and no aspect of society being at all relevant to women, there remains to civic-minded, responsible, thrill-seeking females only to overthrow the government, eliminate the money system, institute complete automation and destroy the male sex.” Total running time: ca. 60 min.

title: Leviticus (15) (AD)
description: Two teenage boys living in an ultraconservative community in rural Australia are threatened by a violent entity seeking to destroy them in this breath-taking queer horror.

title: Teenage Sex and Death at Camp Miasma
description: The infamous Camp Miasma slasher franchise is getting rebooted yet again. But when the latest movie’s director becomes obsessed with the mysterious, reclusive actress who played the “final girl” in the original film, a whole new kind of slasher emerges from the bottom of the lake. Warning: This film contains sequences with flashing or flickering lights that may affect individuals with photosensitivity. Viewer discretion is advised.

title: MYSTERY EROTIC THRILLER
description:
Mystery Erotic Thriller presents undisclosed deep cuts from the genre’s overheated history - from neon-soaked 80s neo-noir and glossy 90s studio sleaze to forgotten direct-to-video delirium. Expect dangerous affairs, obsessive desire, double-crosses, voyeurism, murder and exquisitely bad decisions, as sex becomes a weapon and nobody proves quite as innocent as they first appear. Come blind, surrender to the mystery and discover a film you may never otherwise have thought to see.
These screenings are strictly for adult audiences and may contain explicit sexual content, violence and other potentially offensive material. Do not attend if you are of a sensitive disposition. Adults only.

title: BITTER CHRISTMAS
description: Raúl is a cult filmmaker in the midst of a creative crisis. When tragedy strikes one of his closest collaborators, he draws inspiration from it to write his next film. Little by little, he imagines Elsa, a filmmaker in the midst of writing a script, whose journey begins to mirror his own. The two fi...

title: The Dog Stars
description: Set in a post-apocalyptic world in which a virus has wiped out most of humanity, with survivors being terrorized by roaming scavengers called "Reapers." The protagonist is Hig, a pilot who survived the flu that killed everyone he knew, his wife included. He lives in the hangar of a small abandoned airport with his dog, his only neighbor a gun-toting ex-Marine. Hig sometimes heads off in his 1956 Cessna, where he can fish and pretend things are how they used to be. When a random transmission somehow beams through his radio, the voice ignites a hope deep inside him that a better life might exist if he flies a bit further. He risks it all. to chase a possible haven in Grand Junction.

title: The Samurai and the Prisoner
description: When Lord Murashige Araki (Masahiro Motoki) rises up against the tyrannical Nobunaga Oda (Masaki Suda), he finds himself besieged within the walls of his own castle. Isolated, he is confronted with a series of mysterious crimes that shatter the fragile order of his court, plunging the fortress into fear and suspicion. With Oda’s army closing in and a traitor hiding among his ranks, Murashige is forced into an uneasy alliance with Kanbei Kuroda (Masaki Suda), a brilliant yet dangerous strategist held prisoner in the dungeon. Helped by his wife Chiyoho (Yuriko Yoshitaka) and his most loyal generals, Murashige must uncover the truth before the castle falls. “Kurosawa has made one of his best films, a work that feels a bit like Agatha Christie, a bit like Shakespeare, and even a bit like Samurai Columbo.” – RogerEbert.com

title: Drive (2011)
description: A mysterious Hollywood action film stuntman gets in trouble with gangsters when he tries to help his neighbor’s husband rob a pawn shop while serving as his getaway driver.

title: Chronovisor
description: Inspired by the true story of a “fake” invention, Kevin Walker and Jack Auen’s Chronovisor follows a Columbia professor deep into a Borgesian labyrinth of textual clues pointing to a time-travel device rumored to have been suppressed by the Vatican.

title: Leviticus
description: From the producers of Talk To Me and The Babadook, LEVITICUS is the striking feature debut from writer-director Adrian Chiarella, telling the story of two teenage boys whose forbidden relationship unleashes a terrifying supernatural entity that takes the form of the person they desire most - each other. Blending nerve-shredding suspense with an emotionally powerful love story, the film delivers an unforgettable theatrical experience that lingers long after the credits roll.

title: Bitter Christmas
description:
Presented in Spanish, with English subtitles.

From iconic director Pedro Almodóvar... A dual-timeline story exploring grief, creative block, and the blurry line between real life and fiction.

title: Leviticus
description: Teenage boys Naim and Ryan strike up an unexpected connection. But when their bond draws the attention of their community, a ritual is performed on them, releasing a violent entity. An entity that takes the form of its victim's truest desire.

title: FILIPIÑANA
description: 17-year-old Isabel navigates the opulent pavilions and lush green landscapes of Dr. Palanca’s luxury golf course as a newly-hired “tee girl.” Meticulously composed, highly stylized, and guided by precisely choreographed movement and deadpan delivery, FILIPIÑANA unfolds through the gradual accumulation of everyday encounters between staff and the wealthy clients of this secluded country club on the outskirts of Manila. When she attempts to return a lost golf club, Isabel uncovers a dark underbelly beneath the club’s pristine surfaces, in this sweltering, pastel-colored fairy tale of class division, institutional patriarchy, and invisible violence.

title: Mysterious Skin
description: At the age of eight, Kansas youngsters Neil and Brian played on the same little league baseball team. Now, ten years later, the two boys couldn’t be more different. Neil is a charismatic but emotionally aloof male hustler, while Brian is a nervous introvert obsessed with the idea that he has been abducted by a UFO. When the boys’ parallel lives inevitably intersect, the pair unearth dark, repressed secrets on a harrowing and unforgettable journey of self-discovery. Director’s Statement: “I’m SO excited about the glorious 4K restoration of MYSTERIOUS SKIN! When we made this little indie 20 years ago, we barely had enough money to finish it, let alone pay for a Digital Intermediate and the bells and whistles of a larger studio film. I would never drastically alter the film which has such an amazing and passionate following around the world. However, the incredible tools made possible by modern digital technology helped us polish and enhance the picture in a way that wasn’t possible in the early 00’s. MYSTERIOUS SKIN holds a special place in my heart and I can’t wait for audiences, present and future, to experience this new definitive version of it.” Official Selection: Sundance, TIFF, Venice Film Festival Previous screenings:

description: THE NEW MOVIE BY TOMMY WISEAU! PLEASE NOTE - TOMMY WISEAU WILL BE TAKING TO THE STAGE AT THE FILMS ADVERTISED TIME! Three firefighters, George, Patrick & Tim, must save New Orleans from a gigantic shark. Can New Orleans survive? Please Note: This film contains flickering or flashing lights that may affect those with photosensitive epilepsy.

title: The Sun Never Sets
description: Sat, Aug 22 at 2:30pm: Sneak Preview + Q&A with stars Dakota Fanning and Cory Michael Smith Free-spirited Wendy (Dakota Fanning) is at a crossroads in her relationship with older divorced dad Jack (Jake Johnson, New Girl ) that is only further complicated when an old flame (Cory Michael Smith, Sentimental Value ) re-enters her life. Set in perpetually sunny summertime Anchorage and featuring a career-best performance by Fanning, THE SUN NEVER SETS is a funny and endearing return to form for mumblecore auteur Joe Swanberg. Regular engagement begins Fri, Sep 4. Showtimes to be announced. Official selection: SXSW “Marks a confident return for Swanberg, bolstered by a stellar performance from Fanning and a thoughtful, often painful exploration of love, growth, and the realization that fulfillment doesn’t always come from another person.” – Film Inquiry

title: Heathers
description: NEW 4K RESTORATION “What is your damage, Heather?” Cynical, surreal and viciously funny, this dark high school comedy remains one of the most influential teen movies ever. Iconic performances from 80s luminaries Winona Ryder, Shannen Doherty and Christian Slater, and a cornucopia of gleefully nasty putdowns ( “Lick it up baby. Lick. It. Up.” ) mask an earnest plea for empathy and kindess at the center of HEATHERS’ black heart.

title: GYPSY 83
description: Sandusky, Ohio is hell on earth for goth misfits and Stevie Nicks superfans Gypsy Vale (Sara Rue) and her younger, queer protégée Clive Webb (Birkett Turton). When they discover a New York City club is hosting a “Night of 1000 Stevies,” the pair hit the road with high hopes that Gypsy will be able to perform. Along the way, they encounter other misfits who pave the way to their salvation, all while discovering profound truths about themselves. Costarring John Doe of the legendary punk band X and the great Karen Black as a has-been lounge singer, Todd Stephens’s cult favorite puts a queer, outsider spin on both the road movie and the coming-of-age journey, with plenty of black eyeliner to spare.

title: CatVideoFest 2026
description: Our fuzzy overlords return to the big screen! Vidiots is purrfectly enthralled to bring back the cutest kitty compilation ever! CatVideoFest is a compilation reel of the latest and best cat videos culled from countless hours of unique submissions and sourced animations, music videos, and classic internet powerhouses. CatVideoFest is a joyous communal experience, only available in theaters, and raises money for cats in need through partnerships with local cat charities, animal welfare organizations, and shelters to best serve cats in the area.

title: Colony
description: Horror master Yeon Sang-ho’s ( Train to Busan ) new zombie thriller stars Gianna Jun as biology professor Se-jeong, who’s thrust into a bloody nightmare when a rapidly mutating virus is released during a biotech conference causing authorities to seal the facility. Trapped inside with no escape, Se-jeong along with a small group of survivors must fight to stay alive while the infected undergo horrific transformations. Also starring Koo Kyo-hawn.

title: Stop Making Sense
description: Considered by critics as the greatest concert film of all time, STOP MAKING SENSE stars core band members David Byrne, Tina Weymouth, Chris Frantz, and Jerry Harrison along with Bernie Worrell, Alex Weir, Steve Scales, Lynn Mabry and Edna Holt. The live performance was shot over the course of three nights at Hollywood’s Pantages Theater in December of 1983 and features Talking Heads’ most memorable songs.

title: Bully
description: The true story of a group of Florida teenagers who conspired to kill an abusive classmate who used psychological, physical and sexual violence against them. Staff Pick by Chris Hickey, usher

title: Dead Ringers
description: Twin gynecologists take full advantage of the fact that nobody can tell them apart, until their relationship begins to deteriorate over a woman.

title: Kill Bill: Volume 1
description: Her child is gone. Her team of assassins has betrayed her. Now snatch your Pussy Wagon keychains off the hook and join us as Uma Thurman’s The Bride sets out in her search of vengeance to Kill Bill .

title: Steel
description: The construction of a steel skyscraper becomes a race against time and challenges the sanity of a building foreman and his crew.

title: The Maltese Falcon             / The Petrified Forest
description: Everyone’s looking for it and they’ll do anything to get it! The Maltese Falcon , that is. It’s not just the opulent treasure in the mind’s eye of every San Francisco low-life, it’s also one of the first shining examples of Hollywood noir, a stunningly confident directing debut for John Huston, and a sordid melodrama which transformed Humphrey Bogart from B-movie sideman to star romantic lead. Mary Astor co-stars as the hot-blooded but inscrutable femme fatale who drags hard-boiled private eye Sam Spade (Bogart) into the hunt for the Falcon. Peter Lorre and Sydney Greenstreet (in his Academy Award-nominated film debut!) round out the conspiratorial cast as dandy-gangsters with twisted loyalties. The paradigm for film noir to come, this loaded, sordid mystery gets right to the tragic truth about love and crime: “It’s the stuff that dreams are made of.”

title: Live and Let Die
description: James Bond is sent to stop a diabolically brilliant heroin magnate armed with a complex organization and a reliable tarot reader.
