Mixed Bag (5m 3s) (UK) Being a Fight...

title: How to Divorce During the War
Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs
description: Snow White, orphaned as a child, is forced to work under the reign of her evil stepmother, the Queen, who will stop at nothing to remain the most beautiful being in the land. When Snow White’s beauty grows, so does the Queen’s jealously. Seething with hatred, the Queen concocts a sinister plan to put an end to her. Will the princess escape her fate and achieve her happily ever after? Based on the classic Brothers Grimm fairy tale, this first animated feature from The Walt Disney Company—and the first traditionally animated feature ever produced— was nominated for its original score; the following year, the Academy gave Disney a Special Award for the film (one full-sized Oscar and seven small ones), “recognized as a significant screen innovation which has charmed millions and pioneered a great new entertainment field for the motion picture cartoon.”
director: David Hand, Perce Pearce, William Cottrell, Larry Morey, Wilfred Jackson, Ben Sharpsteen PRODUCED BY: Walt Disney

title: Rio
description: This comedy-adventure centers on Blu, a flightless rare macaw who acts more human than bird. His world is turned upside down…

title: Parent & Baby Screening: Bitter Christmas (15)
description: Pedro Almodóvar is back with his unique brand of storytelling, setting the stage for the tale of a filmmaker who is a little too heavily inspired by the real lives of those around him.

title: Late Fame
description: The great Willem Dafoe lends his delicate gravitas to the role of Ed Saxberger, a forgotten New York poet who works in the post office. After an eager and flattering young admirer (Edmund Donovan) appears on his doorstep, Saxberger is beckoned into a coterie of twenty-something admirers who anoint him as a rediscovered genius. Intoxicated by the attention — and by the alluring presence of Gloria, the group’s“ tragic heroine” (a sinuous, Kurt Weill– crooning Greta Lee) — Saxberger gradually reckons with the authenticity of his newfound poetic circle. This thoughtful, witty second feature from Kent Jones (DIANE), working from a sly and hugely entertaining script by Oscar - nominated screenwriter Samy Burch (MAYDECEMBER), is a wistful yet unromantic look at a lost idea of downtown New York.

title: 2026 Sundance Festival Short Film Tour (Open Captioning)
description: Please note that there are additional showtimes of the 2026 SUNDANCE FILM FESTIVAL SHORT FILM TOUR that screen without open captions (on-screen display of dialogue and sounds). For those showtimes, click here. Curated from this year’s festival, this selection of six standout shorts from around the world includes Jury Award winners THE BOYS AND THE BEES (Nonfiction), CRISIS ACTOR (US Fiction) and LIVING WITHOUT A VISIONARY (Animation) in an eclectic showcase of truly independent filmmaking. Program: Crisis Actor / U.S.A. (Director, Screenwriter, and Producer: Lily Platt, Producers: Sophie Seyd, Alex Bendo, Lexi Preiser) — Fired from her day job, an impulsive actress crashes a support group and spirals into a chaotic night that forces her to face her addiction to drama. Cast: Sarah Steele, Philip Ettinger. Short Film Jury Award: U.S. Fiction The Boys and the Bees / U.S.A. (Director and Producer: Arielle Knight, Producer: Sean Weiner) — On an idyllic farm in rural Georgia, Black beekeeping parents tenderly share their knowledge of life, love, and nature with their young sons while restoring their homestead. Short Film Jury Award: Nonfiction Pankaja / U.S.A., India (Director, Screenwriter, and Producer: Anooya Swamy, Producers: Nakirekanti Swamy, Archana Swamy, Vindhya Gupta) — Pankaja, along with her daughter, Lalli, searches for her missing husband through the city slums of Bangalore to bring him back home. Cast: Harshini Boyalla, Padmashree G. Sauna Sickness / Sweden (Director, Screenwriter, and Producer: Malin Barr) — Struggling to maintain the peace she mistakes for love, Cleo’s steamy New Year’s Eve plans fissure into a chilling nightmare. Cast: Thea Sofie Loch Næss, Adam Lundgren, Magnus Krepper, Sanna Krepper. NY Premiere! Living with a Visionary / U.S.A. (Director, Screenwriter, and Producer: Stephen P. Neary, Producer: Mireia Vilanova) — After 50 years of marriage, John must care for his wife while learning to live alongside her vivid hallucinations. Cast: James Cromwell, Katherine LaVictoire. Short Film Jury Award: Animation Marga en el DF / Mexico, U.S.A. (Director and Screenwriter: Gabriela Ortega, Producers: Karla Luna Cantú, Natalia Gonzalez, Eugenio Valero, Carlos López Estrada, Valerie Bush, Stacy Perskie) — In the wake of Selena Quintanilla’s murder, Marga’s life takes an unexpected turn at 21 weeks pregnant during a surprise visit to Mexico City. Cast: Camila Santana, David Palacio, Xabiani Ponce de León, Andrea de Fátima.

title: Union County (Open Captioning)
description: Please note that there are additional showtimes of UNION COUNTY that screen without open captions (on-screen display of dialogue and sounds). For those showtimes, click here. Will Poulter and Noah Centineo deliver pitch-perfect performances as brothers Cody and Jack Parsons, each navigating a court-mandated drug rehabilitation program in a pocket of rural Ohio hit hard by the opioid epidemic. Provided with hope for the first time since their struggles began and with the support of a tireless counselor (Annette Deao), the brothers work toward a brighter, sober future.

title: Moana Sing-Along
description: Sing along with this modern animated classic of a powerful girl pursuing her destiny and identity! Moana is on a daring mission to save her people, sailing out in the seas of the mighty Pacific with determination. Along the way she meets the once-mighty demigod Maui, who guides her towards her goal of becoming a master way-finder. Together they sail across the open ocean on an action-packed voyage, encountering enormous monsters and impossible odds. Along the way, Moana fulfills the ancient quest of her ancestors and discovers the one thing she always sought: her own identity. With a fun and inspiring soundtrack that includes tracks by Lin-Manuel Miranda, here’s your chance to belt out your favorite tunes with folks who love it as much as you do!

title: UNTIL THE END OF THE WORLD
description: In order to enable his blind wife (Jeanne Moreau) to see, Dr. Farber (Max von Sydow) invents a process that makes it possible to transmit the images recorded in the brains of sighted people directly into the visual systems of blind people. Farber’s son Sam (William Hurt) sets out on a journey around the world in order to “see” and record the various stations of his mother’s life for her. The Frenchwoman Claire (Solveig Dommartin) falls in love with him and sets out in pursuit of him. She, in turn, is followed by the author Eugene (Sam Neill), who is recording her adventure.

title: THE HUNGER GAMES (2026)
description: Based on the best-selling books by Suzanne Collins, The Hunger Games is the first film in the franchise. Every year in the ruins of what was once North America, the Capitol of the nation of Panem forces each of its 12 districts to send a teenage boy and girl to compete to the death in the Hunger Games. Sixteen-year-old Katniss Everdeen (Jennifer Lawrence) volunteers in her younger sister’s place, and must rely upon her sharp instincts when she is pitted against highly trained tributes who have prepared their entire lives for this competition. If she is ever to return home to District 12, Katniss must make impossible choices in the arena that weigh survival against humanity and life against love.

title: Marketa Lazarova
description: Frequently hailed as the greatest Czech film ever made, František Vláčil’s staggering medieval epic, shot in stark widescreen black and white, plunges into the blood-soaked borderlands of 13th-century Bohemia amid the uneasy transition from paganism to Christianity.

title: Ish
description: Set and filmed in the South Asian and Middle Eastern community in Luton, Ish follows 12-year-old best friends, Ish (Farhan Hasnat) and Maram (Yahya Kitana) who are navigating childhood against a backdrop of political tension and personal loss. After a police stop and search, where Maram is searched and Ish manages to run away, they wrestle to hold onto their friendship. Written and directed by acclaimed artist Imran Perretta and co-written by Enda Walsh ( Hunger ), Ish was shot in black and white by cinematographer Jermaine Canute Edwards ( My Father’s Shadow ). The film is less contemporary urban drama and more a classical coming-of-age story in the tradition of The Apu Trilogy , Kes and Ratcatcher .

title: FILIPIÑANA
description: 17-year-old Isabel navigates the opulent pavilions and lush green landscapes of Dr. Palanca’s luxury golf course as a newly-hired “tee girl.” Meticulously composed, highly stylized, and guided by precisely choreographed movement and deadpan delivery, FILIPIÑANA unfolds through the gradual accumulation of everyday encounters between staff and the wealthy clients of this secluded country club on the outskirts of Manila. When she attempts to return a lost golf club, Isabel uncovers a dark underbelly beneath the club’s pristine surfaces, in this sweltering, pastel-colored fairy tale of class division, institutional patriarchy, and invisible violence.

title: CatVideoFest 2026
description: Our fuzzy overlords return to the big screen! Vidiots is purrfectly enthralled to bring back the cutest kitty compilation ever! CatVideoFest is a compilation reel of the latest and best cat videos culled from countless hours of unique submissions and sourced animations, music videos, and classic internet powerhouses. CatVideoFest is a joyous communal experience, only available in theaters, and raises money for cats in need through partnerships with local cat charities, animal welfare organizations, and shelters to best serve cats in the area.

title: YOUTH WITHOUT YOUTH
description: Professor of language and philosophy Dominic Matei (Tim Roth) is struck by lightning and ages backwards from 70 to 40 in a week, attracting the world and the Nazis. While on the run, the professor meets a young woman (Alexandra Maria Lara) who has her own experience with a lightning storm. Not only does Dominic find love again, but her new abilities hold the key to his research.

title: Moana (Live Action)
description: Live-action adaptation of the 2016 Disney animated film

title: Late Fame
description: In Kent Jones’s marvelously witty second feature, a once-upon-a-time New York poet (Willem Dafoe) gets an ego boost when he is welcomed into the world of an emerging literary salon, but must reckon with the authenticity of his newfound circle of twentysomething admirers.

title: Cars (20th Anniversary)
description: Lightning McQueen, a hotshot rookie race car driven to succeed, discovers that life is about the journey, not the finish line, when he finds himself unexpectedly detoured in the sleepy Route 66 town of Radiator Springs. On route across the country to the big Piston Cup Championship in California to compete against two seasoned pros, McQueen gets to know the town's offbeat characters.

title: Onslaught
description: When a rogue squad of genetically engineered super soldiers break loose in the desert, a badass Army sniper must unleash hell to protect her young daughter.

title: WRITTEN ON THE WIND
description: Alcoholism, nymphomania, impotence, and deadly jealousy fill the screen in Douglas Sirk’s Technicolor operatic tragedy, WRITTEN ON THE WIND. Mitch Wayne, played by Rock Hudson, works hard as a geologist for the Texan oil-rich degenerate Hadleys who envelope him in their maelstrom of psychosexual angst and fury.

title: LATE FAME
description: Willem Dafoe is Ed Saxberger, a postal worker whose former life as a downtown poet in late-70s New York is rediscovered by a young admirer (Donovan) and his “Enthusiasm Society,” a group of 20-somethings with a comically romanticized sense of the past. In the company of his new friends, including the mysterious and mercurial Gloria (Lee of PAST LIVES), Ed has the uncanny feeling of merging with his younger self. Directed by Kent Jones (DIANE) from a witty, razor-sharp script by Samy Burch (MAY DECEMBER), LATE FAME is a funny, lively, poignant, and occasionally haunting New York story.

title: Chronovisor
description: Inspired by the true story of a “fake” invention, Kevin Walker and Jack Auen’s Chronovisor follows a Columbia professor deep into a Borgesian labyrinth of textual clues pointing to a time-travel device rumored to have been suppressed by the Vatican.

title: Paw Patrol 3: The Dino Movie
description: The Paw Patrol lands on a mysterious dinosaur island after a storm, where they meet Rex, a stranded pup. When Humdinger's reckless mining triggers a volcano, the team faces their biggest rescue mission yet to save the island Sunday 2nd Aug 11am Charity Screening All proceeds from this performance will be donated to MEDICINEMA Cinema-based healthcare programmes inside hospitals

title: Gandahar
description: An entire civilization must confront its destiny in alternative-animation pioneer René Laloux’s final feature, a cult classic of mind-bending science fiction. In a distant world, a merciless army of automata attacks Gandahar, turning its peace-loving people to stone. Hoping to discover the source of these Men of Metal, a council of matriarchs enlists the brave yet inexperienced warrior Sylvain (Pierre-Marie Escourro), who, while journeying through his planet’s outer regions, teams up with the Deformed, a race cast out from Gandahar after failed science experiments rendered them mutants. Soon, Sylvain learns that a gargantuan brain called Metamorphis (Georges Wilson) is responsible for his utopian society’s strife and—together with the beautiful Airelle (Catherine Chevallier)—travels through time to defeat him, in the process risking their lives and Gandahar’s very existence. Featuring stunningly surreal creatures and wondrously bizarre environments designed by renowned comic-book artist Caza, Gandahar is a visceral, visionary head-trip in which animation opens a gateway to the furthest reaches of the imagination.

title: Oshima: Death By Hanging + Yunbogi's Diary
description: The botched execution of a Korean citizen convicted of rape and murder brings the judiciary system to a halt, as wardens, prosecutors, medics, and even the clergy discuss whether a man who survived his execution can be executed a second time. At one disturbing and oddly amusing, Ōshima's macabre farce is a searing indictment of both capital punishment and the treatment of Korean immigrants in his country. Preceded by Ōshima's experimental documentary from 1965 Yunbogi's Diary .

title: Teenage Sex and Death at Camp Miasma
description: The infamous Camp Miasma slasher franchise is getting rebooted yet again. But when the latest movie’s director becomes obsessed with the mysterious, reclusive actress who played the “final girl” in the original film, a whole new kind of slasher emerges from the bottom of the lake. Warning: This film contains sequences with flashing or flickering lights that may affect individuals with photosensitivity. Viewer discretion is advised.

title: BITTER CHRISTMAS
description: Raúl is a cult filmmaker in the midst of a creative crisis. When tragedy strikes one of his closest collaborators, he draws inspiration from it to write his next film. Little by little, he imagines Elsa, a filmmaker in the midst of writing a script, whose journey begins to mirror his own. The two fi...

title: Spider-Man: Brand New Day
description: A forgotten Peter Parker lives alone as a full-time Spider-Man until mounting pressure triggers a dangerous change and a powerful new enemy emerges.

title: Tony (15) (AD)
description: A 19-year-old Anthony Bourdain travels to Provincetown and stumbles into the chaotic world of a restaurant kitchen, carving out a slice of a summer that will shape the course of his life.

title: Bitter Christmas
description: Bitter Christmas tells two alternating stories, one starring Elsa, an advertising director, in 2004, during a long weekend in December. The second takes place in 2026 and stars Raúl, a screenwriter and director who is writing a script that we soon discover is the story of Elsa, her boyfriend Bonifacio, and her friends Patricia and Natalia. Mixed with fiction, Elsa is, in a way, Raúl's alter ego, who, like him, resorts to autofiction as a solution to a long period of creative drought. He looks inside himself, and he can't help but also look at the people who make up his most intimate universe: his partner and his assistant.

title: Mysterious Skin
description: At the age of eight, Kansas youngsters Neil and Brian played on the same little league baseball team. Now, ten years later, the two boys couldn’t be more different. Neil is a charismatic but emotionally aloof male hustler, while Brian is a nervous introvert obsessed with the idea that he has been abducted by a UFO. When the boys’ parallel lives inevitably intersect, the pair unearth dark, repressed secrets on a harrowing and unforgettable journey of self-discovery. Director’s Statement: “I’m SO excited about the glorious 4K restoration of MYSTERIOUS SKIN! When we made this little indie 20 years ago, we barely had enough money to finish it, let alone pay for a Digital Intermediate and the bells and whistles of a larger studio film. I would never drastically alter the film which has such an amazing and passionate following around the world. However, the incredible tools made possible by modern digital technology helped us polish and enhance the picture in a way that wasn’t possible in the early 00’s. MYSTERIOUS SKIN holds a special place in my heart and I can’t wait for audiences, present and future, to experience this new definitive version of it.” Official Selection: Sundance, TIFF, Venice Film Festival Previous screenings:

title: Pee-wee’s Big Adventure
description: The story of a rebel and his bike. In Tim Burton’s dynamite feature length directorial debut, Pee-wee Herman explodes to life in one of the most exciting, creatively colorful, constantly quotable and enduring comedies of the decade! When his fully customized, fire engine red bicycle is stolen, Pee-wee sets off on a Big Adventure to get it back, hitchhiking cross-country and encountering a quirky cast of new friends along the way.

title: Heathers
description: NEW 4K RESTORATION “What is your damage, Heather?” Cynical, surreal and viciously funny, this dark high school comedy remains one of the most influential teen movies ever. Iconic performances from 80s luminaries Winona Ryder, Shannen Doherty and Christian Slater, and a cornucopia of gleefully nasty putdowns ( “Lick it up baby. Lick. It. Up.” ) mask an earnest plea for empathy and kindess at the center of HEATHERS’ black heart.

title: Off-Circuit: UK PREMIERE Pin de Fartie + Q&A
description: The latest production from boundlessly imaginative Argentine collective El Pampero Cine sees successive pairs of characters bid farewell: a mother and her son, a caretaker and her charge, two actors endlessly rehearsing a scene that will never be performed. A playful spin on theatrical adaptation, Alejo Moguillansky's new film is a delightfully imaginative take on Samuel Beckett's Fin de Partie , punctuated by music, tennis, and another exceptional turn by Laura Paredes. The UK Premiere screening on the 4 September will be followed by an in-person Q&A with Alejo Moguillansky.

title: Fighting Spirit: PROJECT SIFU 2 Panel and Special Screening
description: THIS EVENT IS FREE  Talk and catch up with scholar, author and director Wayne Wong and some of the participants who worked on Project Sifu the follow up to Project Sifu 2025. This time the project included a series of stunt workshops, taking the documentary and short from 2025 on tour and making ano...

title: Fanny & Alexander
description: Swedish auteur Ingmar Bergman’s most sentimental and autobiographical work is set in turn-of-the-century Sweden and appropriately bathed in the candlelit interiors common of the era. Unfolding through the eyes of 10-year-old Alexander, a boy from a wealthy family that operates the town theater, the narrative spans seasons and holidays, marriages and deaths, with small moments of daily life punctuating childhood milestones. Originally conceived as a television miniseries of more than five hours, the final, 188-minute version allowed the visuals of two-time Oscar-winning cinematographer Sven Nykvist ( Fanny & Alexander was one of his wins) to be admired at a scale befitting this epic drama.

title: The Samurai and the Prisoner
description: Join us in the microcinema for Kiyoshi Kurosawa’s ponderous and philosophical samurai epic The Samurai and the Prisoner. When Lord Murashige rises up against the tyrannical Oda, he finds himself besieged within the walls of his own castle. Isolated, he is confronted with a series of mysterious crimes that shatter the fragile order of his court, plunging the fortress into fear and suspicion. With Oda’s army closing in and a traitor hiding among his ranks, Murashige is forced into an uneasy alliance with Kanbei, a brilliant and dangerous strategist held prisoner in the dungeon, as he must outwit his enemies and uncover the truth before time runs out.

Spock, Kirk, and the stalwart crew of the iconic Starship Enterprise are pulled back into action when old nemesis, the menacing villain Khan, steals a top-secret device called Project Genesis. Now the Enterprise is heading towards an intergalactic showdown in space! We’re setting our lasers (and projector) to stun!

title: The Samurai and the Prisoner
description: Kiyoshi Kurosawa’s stately, meticulously composed period drama, set in 16th-century Japan, is a tense and metaphysical whodunit with the director’s characteristic philosophical overtones.

title: The Death of Robin Hood
description: THE DEATH OF ROBIN HOOD is a darker reimagining of the classic Robin Hood tale. Set of its time, the film sees the title character grappling with his past after a life of crime and murder; a battleworn loner who finds himself gravely injured after a battle he thought would be his last. In the hands of a mysterious woman, he is offered a chance at salvation.

title: PEGGY SUE GOT MARRIED
description: “Peggy Sue Bodell (Kathleen Turner) isn’t even sure she wants to go to her 25th high school reunion. Recently separated from Charlie (Nicolas Cage), the husband she had to marry at 18, even the idea of turning up where everyone will ask, ‘Where’s Crazy Charlie?,’ the wackiest businessman in TV ads, makes her cringe... As they’re crowning the Reunion King and Queen, Peggy Sue faints, coming to in 1960, a 43-year-old in an 18-year-old’s body. She knows the future all too well, from panty hose to the Pill. She’s seen Charlie give up his dreams of being a singer and slip into the family business—with a bit of philandering on the side. Apparently stuck reliving her last weeks of high school, should she should muck with her destiny or not?” – Sheila Benson, Los Angeles Times

title: Marketa Lazarova
description: Frequently hailed as the greatest Czech film ever made, František Vláčil’s staggering medieval epic, shot in stark widescreen black and white, plunges into the blood-soaked borderlands of 13th-century Bohemia amid the uneasy transition from paganism to Christianity.

title: The Samurai and the Prisoner
description: When Lord Murashige Araki (Masahiro Motoki) rises up against the tyrannical Nobunaga Oda (Masaki Suda), he finds himself besieged within the walls of his own castle. Isolated, he is confronted with a series of mysterious crimes that shatter the fragile order of his court, plunging the fortress into fear and suspicion. With Oda’s army closing in and a traitor hiding among his ranks, Murashige is forced into an uneasy alliance with Kanbei Kuroda (Masaki Suda), a brilliant yet dangerous strategist held prisoner in the dungeon. Helped by his wife Chiyoho (Yuriko Yoshitaka) and his most loyal generals, Murashige must uncover the truth before the castle falls. “Kurosawa has made one of his best films, a work that feels a bit like Agatha Christie, a bit like Shakespeare, and even a bit like Samurai Columbo.” – RogerEbert.com

description: Animated comedy adventure in which the Minions try their hand at filmmaking when they arrive in Hollywood during the 1920s.

title: SAMBA TRAORÉ
description: The only surviving accomplice of a gas station robbery gone bad, Samba Traoré flees the scene of the crime with a suitcase full of cash for his native village in rural Burkina Faso. There he attempts to make a fresh start while hiding how he came by his new fortune from those around him. Despite marrying the beautiful Saratou, earning the affection of her ten-year-old son, and opening a bar with his childhood friend, Samba’s newfound happiness is put to the test as he struggles to cope with the moral crisis of his crimes.

title: First Cow
description: First Cow. 2019. USA. Directed by Kelly Reichardt. Screenplay by Reichardt, Jonathan Raymond, based on Raymond’s book. With John Magaro, Orion Lee, Toby Jones, Ewen Bremner, Scott Shepherd, Gary Farmer, Lily Gladstone. DCP. 121 min. In early-19th-century Oregon Territory, Cookie (John Magaro), a sensitive outsider in debt to brutish fur traders, and King Lu (Orion Lee), an affable, philosophizing Chinese immigrant, form a tender brotherhood amid rough surroundings. The two dream of a better future—and find a way to finance one with the arrival of the territory’s first cow, whose milk they surreptitiously turn into sweet treats to sell. Though cinematographer Christopher Blauvelt cocoons the viewer in verdant nature, moonlight, and the warmth of human connection, the very real terrors of capitalism and colonialism are never too far out of frame. In her seventh feature, Kelly Reichardt masterfully weaves these complex themes together, creating an intimate glimpse of the grand tragedy and beauty of the American experiment.

title: Oshima: Diary of a Shinjuku Thief
description: When a thief is caught stealing form a book shop by one of its employees, the two embark on an unusual, erotic adventure. Set against the vivid backdrop of the massive student-led riots, Nagisa Ōshima's radical concoction of cinema verité, underground kabuki and just about everything in-between is a striking meditation on the psychosexual ambiguities of the postwar counterculture.

title: WISE BLOOD
description:
Returning from military service to a transformed American South, Hazel Motes arrives in a small Georgia city determined to reject the religious convictions that shaped his childhood. Proclaiming himself the founder of the "Church Without Christ", he embarks on a furious campaign against belief, attracting a succession of eccentric followers, opportunists, and would-be prophets. As Hazel's crusade against faith grows increasingly obsessive, his attempts to escape spiritual certainty lead him toward acts of self-destruction that mirror the fervour he claims to oppose.
Adapted from Flannery O'Connor's 1952 novel, Wise Blood occupies a distinctive place within John Huston's later work, combining Southern Gothic, black comedy, and religious allegory. Filmed in Georgia near O'Connor's home territory and closely preserving the novel's dialogue and structure, the film translates her world of preachers, charlatans, and spiritual seekers into a landscape where belief and disbelief become equally consuming forces. Anchored by Brad Dourif's remarkable performance, Wise Blood explores evangelical culture, American individualism, and the uneasy relationship between modernity and faith, resulting in one of the most unusual literary adaptations of the 1970s.

Bring binoculars if you have them! About WILD INSIDE: A Eurasian Eagle-Owl named Flaco escapes from the Central Park Zoo and sets off on a magical odyssey through the island of Manhattan. Flaco overcomes his years of captivity and lack of survival skills to answer the call of the wild – and discovers he was wild inside all along.

description: The great Willem Dafoe lends his delicate gravitas to the role of Ed Saxberger, a forgotten New York poet who works in the post office. After an eager and flattering young admirer (Edmund Donovan) appears on his doorstep, Saxberger is beckoned into a coterie of twenty-something admirers who anoint him as a rediscovered genius. Intoxicated by the attention — and by the alluring presence of Gloria, the group’s“ tragic heroine” (a sinuous, Kurt Weill– crooning Greta Lee) — Saxberger gradually reckons with the authenticity of his newfound poetic circle. This thoughtful, witty second feature from Kent Jones (DIANE), working from a sly and hugely entertaining script by Oscar - nominated screenwriter Samy Burch (MAYDECEMBER), is a wistful yet unromantic look at a lost idea of downtown New York.

Up.” ) mask an earnest plea for empathy and kindess at the center of HEATHERS’ black heart.

title: A Free Woman
description: On the cusp of marriage, Liana becomes convinced she shouldn't live a life in service of a man. Instead, she leaves for Amalfi, where she embarks on an affair. From there she makes for Paris, but each new adventure is compromised by some kind of emotional constraint, culminating in a final act of tragedy. Vittorio Cottafavi's remarkably modern exploration of female autonomy exhibits the melodramatic finesse of Douglas Sirk with a style reminiscent of Max Ophuls. A Free Woman has been newly restored by Radiance.

title: THE RAINMAKER
description: “We’re back in ingénue Southern lawyer territory, following law school grad Rudy Baylor (Damon) through his inaugural case to a mercurial triumph against the odds. So far, so insipid; thankfully, the story is less the usual addled potboiler than a diary of civil litigation—centring on Rudy’s pursuit of a giant insurance company accused of stalling on health claims arising from policies marketed to the poor and unrepresented, such as his client Donny Ray Black (Whitworth). Rudy describes the dilemma of his calling in voice-over, musing over ideals and corruptions, compromises and lawyer jokes. His pilgrim’s progress leads us through an entertaining gallery of lawyerly archetypes. There’s the cynic, Rudy’s long sold-out adversary Leo F. Drummond (Voight); the corrupt, his low-life employer Bruiser Stone (Rourke); and the merely ignoble, his ‘paralawyer’ assistant Deck Schifflet (DeVito). There’s a wider perspective on the legal action, too, counterpointing Rudy’s ‘rainmaking’ lawsuit with both a damp squib of another case, and a subplot involving Danes’ abused wife which suggests the limitations of the law.” – Time Out

Little by little, he imagines Elsa, a filmmaker in the midst of writing a script, whose journey begins to mirror his own. The two fi...

description:
Presented in Spanish, with English subtitles.

From iconic director Pedro Almodóvar... A dual-timeline story exploring grief, creative block, and the blurry line between real life and fiction.

title: The Death of Robin Hood
description: THE DEATH OF ROBIN HOOD is a darker reimagining of the classic Robin Hood tale. Set of its time, the film sees the title character grappling with his past after a life of crime and murder; a battleworn loner who finds himself gravely injured after a battle he thought would be his last. In the hands of a mysterious woman, he is offered a chance at salvation.

title: Your Name.
description: One morning, rural schoolgirl Mitsuha and city kid Taki awaken to discover that they’ve switched bodies. The total strangers struggle to navigate each other’s lives, walking tightropes of intimacy and distance. But when they finally resolve to meet, the true nature of their connection threatens to seal their fate.

title: LATE FAME
description: Willem Dafoe is Ed Saxberger, a postal worker whose former life as a downtown poet in late-70s New York is rediscovered by a young admirer (Donovan) and his “Enthusiasm Society,” a group of 20-somethings with a comically romanticized sense of the past. In the company of his new friends, including the mysterious and mercurial Gloria (Lee of PAST LIVES), Ed has the uncanny feeling of merging with his younger self. Directed by Kent Jones (DIANE) from a witty, razor-sharp script by Samy Burch (MAY DECEMBER), LATE FAME is a funny, lively, poignant, and occasionally haunting New York story.

title: WHAT GODMILOW TAUGHT
description: FILMMAKER IN PERSON! In 2012, Jill Godmilow wrote to Mireia Sallarès, moved by the film she had made in Mexico about women’s orgasms. For Godmilow, who offered to help distribute the film in the U.S., LAS MUERTES CHIQUITAS (THE LITTLE DEATHS) is not a documentary about a problem of Mexican women, it is a film about orgasms as a political issue that affects everyone and raises the question of who can take responsibility for it by speaking out. How to take responsibility for our problems, how to take charge of them by making political films, was the concern that had led Godmilow to engage years earlier with Harun Farocki’s documentary INEXTINGUISHABLE FIRE, which showed how napalm production during the Vietnam War effectively exempted its makers from any responsibility for it. The fact that Farocki’s film had not been seen in the U.S. and that the problem it raised had not gone away, Godmilow decided to recreate it, in order to involve herself in the problem and put it back into circulation. As a statement about what it means today to be an author, and taking account of this complexity by broadening and politicizing the chain of authorship, she titled her replica WHAT FAROCKI TAUGHT. The present film, WHAT GODMILOW TAUGHT (2014), is a film conversation in which Mireia Sallarès captures Jill Godmilow’s commitment to a political life. Sallarès’s film engages with an artistic practice in which having an idea entails a responsibility, and in which grappling with a political problem requires collaborating with others to make useful films. Followed by: Jill Godmilow ECSTATIC ORGASM 7.5-min excerpt from an unfinished film, digital Total running time: ca. 60 min.

title: Late Fame
description: In Kent Jones’s marvelously witty second feature, a once-upon-a-time New York poet (Willem Dafoe) gets an ego boost when he is welcomed into the world of an emerging literary salon, but must reckon with the authenticity of his newfound circle of twentysomething admirers.

title: Sherman's March
description: Sherman’s March , winner of the Grand Jury Prize for Best Documentary at Sundance in 1987, is Ross McElwee’s monumental documentary which has been officially listed by the International Documentary Association as one of the top 20 documentary films of all time. Intending to make a film about General Sherman’s 1864 March to the Sea, Ross McElwee gets sidetracked. Affected by a recent breakup, he slows his progress through the American South to spend time with a succession of women and explore the possibility of romantic fulfilment in the nuclear age.

description: A 19-year-old Anthony Bourdain travels to Provincetown and stumbles into the chaotic world of a restaurant kitchen, setting off a summer that will shape the course of his life.

description: Inspired by the true story of a “fake” invention, Kevin Walker and Jack Auen’s Chronovisor follows a Columbia professor deep into a Borgesian labyrinth of textual clues pointing to a time-travel device rumored to have been suppressed by the Vatican.

title: PREVIEW! Bad Apples
description: Join us this National Cinerma Weekend for a special preview screening of Bad Apples , Saoirse Ronan's first feature in 2 years. Maria, a primary school teacher doing her best to inspire a class of 10-year-olds, is stifled by one unruly and chaotic student. With her career in question and the child's behaviour spiralling, she makes a series of bad decisions that lead to her accidentally taking and locking this "bad apple" in her home. Maria tries desperately to backtrack, but when the class starts flourishing and the staff and parents are thrilled with the improvement, she finds herself in a very complicated predicament...

title: Late Fame (15)
description: A forgotten postman’s poetry collection finds new admirers in a story about how the mystique of the past filters into the present.

title: Twice Upon A Time
description: In a land where dreams are born, the evil Synonamess Botch sets in motion a plan to give humanity non-stop nightmares that threatens the flow of time itself. Only a motley crew of creatures, including an adorable shapeshifter, a floral aspiring actress, a snarky Fairy Godmother, and a mime straight out of the silent film era, can save both the world and people's sleeping habits.

title: Late Fame
description: Willem Defoe plays Ed Saxberger, a forgotten New York poet, who works in the post office. After an eager and flattering young admirer appears on his doorstep, Saxberger is beckoned into a coterie of twentysomething admirers who anoint him as a rediscovered genius. Intoxicated by the attention — and by the alluring presence of Gloria, the group’s “tragic heroine” — Saxberger gradually reckons with the authenticity of his newfound poetic circle. Kent Jones's thoughtful, witty film is a wistful yet unromantic look at a lost idea of downtown New York.

description: The infamous Camp Miasma slasher franchise is getting rebooted yet again. But when the latest movie’s director becomes obsessed with the mysterious, reclusive actress who played the “final girl” in the original film, a whole new kind of slasher emerges from the bottom of the lake. title: JUBILEE
description:
After an encounter with the occult philosopher John Dee, Queen Elizabeth I is transported from the sixteenth century into a near-future Britain marked by social collapse, media saturation, and authoritarian control. Arriving in a London populated by punk gangs, aspiring pop stars, political extremists, and cultural opportunists, she witnesses a society in which traditional institutions have disintegrated and power has been absorbed by entertainment, violence, and spectacle. Moving between squats, wastelands, recording studios, and ruined urban spaces, the film unfolds as a series of encounters rather than a conventional narrative.
Widely regarded as the first British punk film, Jubilee emerged directly from the cultural ferment of late-1970s London and features appearances from figures associated with the punk and post-punk scene, including Toyah Willcox, Jordan, Adam Ant, and Gene October. Rather than functioning as a celebration of punk culture, Derek Jarman's film subjects both the establishment and the counterculture to sustained scrutiny, presenting a vision of Britain shaped by commodification, nationalism, and social decay. Combining historical fantasy, political satire, and experimental filmmaking, Jubilee remains one of the key cinematic responses to the economic and cultural crises that transformed Britain during the 1970s.

Adam Meeks & stars Will Poulter & Annette Deao, moderated by Danny Strong, Fri Aug 14 at 7:00 show Q&A with dir. Adam Meeks & stars Will Poulter & Annette Deao Sat Aug 15 at 7:00 show Q&A with dir. Adam Meeks & stars Will Poulter & Annette Deao Sun Aug 16 at 2:00 show Will Poulter and Noah Centineo deliver pitch-perfect performances as brothers Cody and Jack Parsons, each navigating a court-mandated drug rehabilitation program in a pocket of rural Ohio hit hard by the opioid epidemic. Provided with hope for the first time since their struggles began and with the support of a tireless counselor (Annette Deao), the brothers work toward a brighter, sober future. Additional showtimes for Aug 14-20 to be announced.

title: The Sun Never Sets
description: Sat, Aug 22 at 2:30pm: Sneak Preview + Q&A with stars Dakota Fanning and Cory Michael Smith Free-spirited Wendy (Dakota Fanning) is at a crossroads in her relationship with older divorced dad Jack (Jake Johnson, New Girl ) that is only further complicated when an old flame (Cory Michael Smith, Sentimental Value ) re-enters her life. Set in perpetually sunny summertime Anchorage and featuring a career-best performance by Fanning, THE SUN NEVER SETS is a funny and endearing return to form for mumblecore auteur Joe Swanberg. Regular engagement begins Fri, Sep 4. Showtimes to be announced. Official selection: SXSW “Marks a confident return for Swanberg, bolstered by a stellar performance from Fanning and a thoughtful, often painful exploration of love, growth, and the realization that fulfillment doesn’t always come from another person.” – Film Inquiry

title: Gandahar
description: An entire civilization must confront its destiny in alternative-animation pioneer René Laloux’s final feature, a cult classic of mind-bending science fiction. In a distant world, a merciless army of automata attacks Gandahar, turning its peace-loving people to stone. Hoping to discover the source of these Men of Metal, a council of matriarchs enlists the brave yet inexperienced warrior Sylvain (Pierre-Marie Escourro), who, while journeying through his planet’s outer regions, teams up with the Deformed, a race cast out from Gandahar after failed science experiments rendered them mutants. Soon, Sylvain learns that a gargantuan brain called Metamorphis (Georges Wilson) is responsible for his utopian society’s strife and—together with the beautiful Airelle (Catherine Chevallier)—travels through time to defeat him, in the process risking their lives and Gandahar’s very existence. Featuring stunningly surreal creatures and wondrously bizarre environments designed by renowned comic-book artist Caza, Gandahar is a visceral, visionary head-trip in which animation opens a gateway to the furthest reaches of the imagination.

title: 2026 Sundance Film Festival Short Film Tour
description: Curated from this year’s festival, this selection of six standout shorts from around the world includes Jury Award winners THE BOYS AND THE BEES (Nonfiction), CRISIS ACTOR (US Fiction) and LIVING WITHOUT A VISIONARY (Animation) in an eclectic showcase of truly independent filmmaking.
director: Arielle C. Knight, Lily Platt, Stephen P. Neary, Gabriela Ortega, Anooya Swamy, Malin Barr

title: Tremors
description: There’s something under the ground! An isolated town is on the menu for the giant, subterranean Graboids and it is up to Kevin Bacon, Fred Ward, Michael Gross, and Reba McEntire to get everyone out alive! With some of the best monster effects of the entire 1990s on full display in the desert sun, this cult-classic delivers the scares, thrills, and laughs of a creature feature that is truly Perfection.

title: I VITELLONI
description: Five young men linger in a postadolescent limbo, dreaming of adventure and escape from their small seacoast town. They while away their time spending the lira doled out by their indulgent families on drink, women and nights at the local pool hall. Federico Fellini’s second solo directorial effort is a semiautobiographical masterpiece of sharply drawn character sketches: Skirt chaser Fausto, forced to marry a girl he has impregnated; Alberto, the perpetual child; Leopoldo, a writer thirsting for fame; and Moraldo, the only member of the group troubled by a moral conscience. An international success and recipient of an Academy Award nomination for Best Original Screenplay, I VITELLONI compassionately details a year in the life of a group of small-town layabouts struggling to find meaning in their lives.

title: "There They Go-Go-Go!" / A FEW GOOD MEN
description: Wile E. Coyote is so hungry that he forms a chicken out of mud, bakes it and tries to eat it, causing one of his teeth to fall out. He throws the mud bird away when a real one comes along – the Road Runner, who runs so fast that he literally burns up the road, setting Wile E.’s feet on fire!

title: Heathers
description: NEW 4K RESTORATION “What is your damage, Heather?” Cynical, surreal and viciously funny, this dark high school comedy remains one of the most influential teen movies ever. Iconic performances from 80s luminaries Winona Ryder, Shannen Doherty and Christian Slater, and a cornucopia of gleefully nasty putdowns ( “Lick it up baby. Lick. It. Up.” ) mask an earnest plea for empathy and kindess at the center of HEATHERS’ black heart.

title: FILIPIÑANA
description: 17-year-old Isabel navigates the opulent pavilions and lush green landscapes of Dr. Palanca’s luxury golf course as a newly-hired “tee girl.” Meticulously composed, highly stylized, and guided by precisely choreographed movement and deadpan delivery, FILIPIÑANA unfolds through the gradual accumulation of everyday encounters between staff and the wealthy clients of this secluded country club on the outskirts of Manila. When she attempts to return a lost golf club, Isabel uncovers a dark underbelly beneath the club’s pristine surfaces, in this sweltering, pastel-colored fairy tale of class division, institutional patriarchy, and invisible violence.

title: Marketa Lazarova
description: Frequently hailed as the greatest Czech film ever made, František Vláčil’s staggering medieval epic, shot in stark widescreen black and white, plunges into the blood-soaked borderlands of 13th-century Bohemia amid the uneasy transition from paganism to Christianity.

title: Lingua Franca
description: Lingua Franca. 2019. USA/Philippines. Written and directed by Isabel Sandoval. With Sandoval, Eamon Farren, Ivory Aquino, P.J. Boudousqué, Lev Gorn, Lynn Cohen. DCP. In English, Cebuano, Filipino, Russian. 84 min. In her third feature film (and her first primarily in English), actor-director Isabel Sandoval plays Olivia, an undocumented Filipina trans woman who works as a caregiver for Olga, an elderly Russian Jewish woman with early dementia living in New York’s Brighton Beach. Fearing capture and deportation by ICE, Olivia splits her meager earnings between her family in the Philippines and an American-born man with whom she hopes to secure permanent residency through a marriage of convenience. When she crosses paths with Alex, Olga’s grandson, after he returns home from mandated rehab in Russia, her plans—and future—are upended by the power of affection and the hidden pains of displacement.

title: Live folk music, Czech drinks + The Cassandra Cat
description: To celebrate the start of our new season of Czechoslovak New Wave cinema, members are invited to join us on Saturday…

title: Onslaught
description: When a rogue squad of genetically engineered super soldiers break loose in the desert, a badass Army sniper must unleash hell to protect her young daughter.

title: Tales from the Darkside: The Movie
description: A young boy tells three stories of horror to distract a witch who plans to eat him.

title: ROY COHN/JACK SMITH
description: From one of the seminal theatrical events of the 1990s – Ron Vawter’s extraordinary performance piece ROY COHN/JACK SMITH – Godmilow crafts a dramatically deft, comic, and terrifying film diptych. Roy Cohn, the homophobic right-wing lawyer and sleazy back-room politico, thunders against the Sodom and Gomorrah of homosexuality at a banquet for the American Society for the Protection of the Family, while across town and light years away, the notorious underground filmmaker of FLAMING CREATURES fame, Jack Smith, in flamboyant harem drag, constructs his own private resistance theater from fragments of Arabian Nights kitsch, avant-garde film feuds, and passionate B-movie camp. Vawter performs both men exquisitely in this film about the closet, where silence is powerful, but from which both of these infamous homosexuals from the repressive and punishing 1950s convey privileged knowledge of Queerness in brilliant performances of their own – Cohn using politics as a form of drag and Smith turning drag into an extraordinary form of politics, pathos, and jouissance. Cohn and Smith had nothing in common except their homosexuality and their death from AIDS in the late 1980s; Vawter, who accepts and produces both men through his own voice and body, would himself die of AIDS, just six months after the film was shot.

title: The Odyssey
description: The Odyssey (2026), Christopher Nolan’s epic adaptation of Homer’s classic, follows Greek hero Odysseus on a perilous journey home after the Trojan War, encountering gods, monsters, and treacherous seas while his family faces turmoil in Ithaca Photo Id may required for 15 certificate films

title: RUMBLE FISH
description: “Shot back-to-back with THE OUTSIDERS, similarly based on a novel by S.E. Hinton, and signalled by Coppola as ‘Camus for kids’, RUMBLE FISH does indeed have a hero figure (Rourke) who belongs to a former age of existential ‘outsiders’, coasting through the world in an insulated state of deafness and colour blindness from too many rumbles. His kid brother (Dillon) idolises him, but is too careless to see the damage done to all concerned by the continuous gang-fights of frightful violence but no importance.” – Time Out

description: On an Orkney isle, siblings Isla and Sandy hunt birds and talk to mythical beings while fighting off outsiders. Their lives change when Daniel, an awkward official, arrives to relocate them.

title: Terminator 2: Judgment Day (35th Anniversary)
description: A cyborg, identical to the one who failed to kill Sarah Connor, must now protect her teenage son, John Connor, from a more advanced and powerful cyborg.

title: Tony
description: A 19-year-old Anthony Bourdain travels to Provincetown and stumbles into the chaotic world of a restaurant kitchen, setting off a summer that will shape the course of his life.

title: After Hours
description: Cheech and Chong! Sultry sculptress Linda Fiorentino! Bad Brains! These are but a few of the characters that Midtown computer jockey Paul Hackett (Griffin Dunne) will encounter when venturing into the wilds of a pre-gentrification downtown New York without a penny to his name or the means to get back home in Scorsese’s bravura black comedy of class resentment, all-pervasive paranoia, and creeping castration anxiety, in which the director can be briefly spotted manning a spotlight at punk rock dive Club Berlin. As Dick Miller’s diner waiter explains to the hapless Hackett, “Different rules apply when it gets this late…” As true of the city in 1985 as it is today. Part of This Night Has Opened My Eyes

title: Matador
description: Pedro Almodóvar's 1986 erotic thriller explores the intimate relationship between pleasure and death through the convergence of bullfighting and murder. Diego is an ex-champion matador who now runs a bullfighting school. Still looking for a kick, he watches sadistic videos for sexual pleasure. Maria is a lawyer and Diego’s number one fan – she also likes to kill men with a hairpin at the point of orgasm. The pair are destined to meet.

title: The Incomer (12A) (AD)
description: On an Orkney isle, siblings Isla and Sandy fend off outsiders and commune with mythical beings, until an awkward official arrives to relocate them.

title: Leviticus
description: From the producers of Talk To Me and The Babadook, LEVITICUS is the striking feature debut from writer-director Adrian Chiarella, telling the story of two teenage boys whose forbidden relationship unleashes a terrifying supernatural entity that takes the form of the person they desire most - each other. Blending nerve-shredding suspense with an emotionally powerful love story, the film delivers an unforgettable theatrical experience that lingers long after the credits roll.

title: Little Miss Sunshine
description: A family loaded with quirky, colorful characters piles into an old van and road trips to California for little Olive to compete in a beauty pageant.

title: Leviticus (15) (AD)
description: Two teenage boys living in an ultraconservative community in rural Australia are threatened by a violent entity seeking to destroy them in this breath-taking queer horror.

title: The Dog Stars
description: Set in a post-apocalyptic world in which a virus has wiped out most of humanity, with survivors being terrorized by roaming scavengers called "Reapers." The protagonist is Hig, a pilot who survived the flu that killed everyone he knew, his wife included. He lives in the hangar of a small abandoned airport with his dog, his only neighbor a gun-toting ex-Marine. Hig sometimes heads off in his 1956 Cessna, where he can fish and pretend things are how they used to be. When a random transmission somehow beams through his radio, the voice ignites a hope deep inside him that a better life might exist if he flies a bit further. He risks it all. to chase a possible haven in Grand Junction.

title: The Samurai and the Prisoner
description: When Lord Murashige Araki (Masahiro Motoki) rises up against the tyrannical Nobunaga Oda (Masaki Suda), he finds himself besieged within the walls of his own castle. Isolated, he is confronted with a series of mysterious crimes that shatter the fragile order of his court, plunging the fortress into fear and suspicion. With Oda’s army closing in and a traitor hiding among his ranks, Murashige is forced into an uneasy alliance with Kanbei Kuroda (Masaki Suda), a brilliant yet dangerous strategist held prisoner in the dungeon. Helped by his wife Chiyoho (Yuriko Yoshitaka) and his most loyal generals, Murashige must uncover the truth before the castle falls. “Kurosawa has made one of his best films, a work that feels a bit like Agatha Christie, a bit like Shakespeare, and even a bit like Samurai Columbo.” – RogerEbert.com

title: Chronovisor
description: Inspired by the true story of a “fake” invention, Kevin Walker and Jack Auen’s Chronovisor follows a Columbia professor deep into a Borgesian labyrinth of textual clues pointing to a time-travel device rumored to have been suppressed by the Vatican.

title: I Want Your Sex
description: Gregg Araki's I Want Your Sex tells the story of Elliot (Cooper Hoffman), a kind-hearted if unmotivated twentysomething whose fantasies quickly come true when he lands a job with renowned artist and provocateur Erika Tracy (Olivia Wilde). When Erika breaks down office boundaries and takes Elliot on as her sexual muse and subordinate, their sexually charged relationship makes him question his own desires, boundaries, and relationships with his uptight girlfriend (Charli XCX) and repressed roommate (Chase Sui Wonders). As the stakes heighten and power dynamics shift, the film mixes satire, romantic comedy, mystery, and murder through the colourful and edgy visual language for which Araki is best known.

title: Bitter Christmas
description: Bitter Christmas tells two alternating stories, one starring Elsa, an advertising director, in 2004, during a long weekend in December. The second takes place in 2026 and stars Raúl, a screenwriter and director who is writing a script that we soon discover is the story of Elsa, her boyfriend Bonifacio, and her friends Patricia and Natalia. Mixed with fiction, Elsa is, in a way, Raúl's alter ego, who, like him, resorts to autofiction as a solution to a long period of creative drought. He looks inside himself, and he can't help but also look at the people who make up his most intimate universe: his partner and his assistant.

title: Leviticus
description: Teenage boys Naim and Ryan strike up an unexpected connection. But when their bond draws the attention of their community, a ritual is performed on them, releasing a violent entity. An entity that takes the form of its victim's truest desire.

title: FILIPIÑANA
description: 17-year-old Isabel navigates the opulent pavilions and lush green landscapes of Dr. Palanca’s luxury golf course as a newly-hired “tee girl.” Meticulously composed, highly stylized, and guided by precisely choreographed movement and deadpan delivery, FILIPIÑANA unfolds through the gradual accumulation of everyday encounters between staff and the wealthy clients of this secluded country club on the outskirts of Manila. When she attempts to return a lost golf club, Isabel uncovers a dark underbelly beneath the club’s pristine surfaces, in this sweltering, pastel-colored fairy tale of class division, institutional patriarchy, and invisible violence.

title: Mysterious Skin
description: At the age of eight, Kansas youngsters Neil and Brian played on the same little league baseball team. Now, ten years later, the two boys couldn’t be more different. Neil is a charismatic but emotionally aloof male hustler, while Brian is a nervous introvert obsessed with the idea that he has been abducted by a UFO. When the boys’ parallel lives inevitably intersect, the pair unearth dark, repressed secrets on a harrowing and unforgettable journey of self-discovery. Director’s Statement: “I’m SO excited about the glorious 4K restoration of MYSTERIOUS SKIN! When we made this little indie 20 years ago, we barely had enough money to finish it, let alone pay for a Digital Intermediate and the bells and whistles of a larger studio film. I would never drastically alter the film which has such an amazing and passionate following around the world. However, the incredible tools made possible by modern digital technology helped us polish and enhance the picture in a way that wasn’t possible in the early 00’s. MYSTERIOUS SKIN holds a special place in my heart and I can’t wait for audiences, present and future, to experience this new definitive version of it.” Official Selection: Sundance, TIFF, Venice Film Festival Previous screenings:

title: Big Shark with Tommy Wiseau live on stage
description: THE NEW MOVIE BY TOMMY WISEAU! PLEASE NOTE - TOMMY WISEAU WILL BE TAKING TO THE STAGE AT THE FILMS ADVERTISED TIME! Please arrive 30 mins early to collect your ticket, take your seat, grab merch and meet Tommy before the film starts! Yes we know the shows are allocated seating, but if you all arrive at the advertised time we end up with a very busy foyer / bar & you won't get to your seat when the Q&A starts! ------------------------------------ From the creator of THE ROOM, join us for the return of Tommy Wiseau's BIG SHARK with TOMMY WISEAU LIVE AND IN PERSON from 3rd SEPTEMBER 2026! Three firefighters, George, Patrick & Tim, must save New Orleans from a gigantic shark. Can New Orleans survive? Please Note: This film contains flickering or flashing lights that may affect those with photosensitive epilepsy.

title: The Sun Never Sets
description: Sat, Aug 22 at 2:30pm: Sneak Preview + Q&A with stars Dakota Fanning and Cory Michael Smith Free-spirited Wendy (Dakota Fanning) is at a crossroads in her relationship with older divorced dad Jack (Jake Johnson, New Girl ) that is only further complicated when an old flame (Cory Michael Smith, Sentimental Value ) re-enters her life. Set in perpetually sunny summertime Anchorage and featuring a career-best performance by Fanning, THE SUN NEVER SETS is a funny and endearing return to form for mumblecore auteur Joe Swanberg. Regular engagement begins Fri, Sep 4. Showtimes to be announced. Official selection: SXSW “Marks a confident return for Swanberg, bolstered by a stellar performance from Fanning and a thoughtful, often painful exploration of love, growth, and the realization that fulfillment doesn’t always come from another person.” – Film Inquiry

title: Heathers
description: NEW 4K RESTORATION “What is your damage, Heather?” Cynical, surreal and viciously funny, this dark high school comedy remains one of the most influential teen movies ever. Iconic performances from 80s luminaries Winona Ryder, Shannen Doherty and Christian Slater, and a cornucopia of gleefully nasty putdowns ( “Lick it up baby. Lick. It. Up.” ) mask an earnest plea for empathy and kindess at the center of HEATHERS’ black heart.

title: Kill Bill: Vol. 1 on 35mm
description: Your Saturday night just got a whole lot more kick ass as Quentin Tarantino’s Kill Bill ignites our big screen with an onslaught of celluloid action! A former assassin, known simply as The Bride (Uma Thurman), wakes from a coma four years after her jealous ex-lover Bill (David Carradine) attempts to murder her on her wedding day. Fueled by an insatiable desire for revenge, she vows to get even with every person who contributed to the loss of her unborn child, her entire wedding party, and four years of her life. After devising a hit list, The Bride sets off on her quest, enduring unspeakable injury and unscrupulous enemies. So, hop in your p***ywagon and get ready for a maelstrom of revenge so bad ass and bloody, you might never recover!

title: DER FAN
description: Simone (the magnetic Désirée Nosbusch) is a teenage runaway who is obsessed with the pop singer known as “R.” Soon, that obsession takes over her life. When “R” uses Simone with machine-like coldness, she plots her revenge with an unholy ceremony that’s equally romantic and horrifying. Fueled by a killer minimalist synth soundtrack from Rheingold and a gorgeous design aesthetic, DER FAN is a subversive and electric shocker that goes harder than you’d ever expect it to go.

title: Michael Mann's Manhunter: The Final Cut
description: Mann’s genre-defining serial-killer thriller returns in a stunning new restoration overseen by the filmmaker himself. A retired criminal profiler (William Petersen) reluctantly returns to the FBI to help track down a murderer and is forced to consult an expert—the imprisoned Dr. Hannibal Lecktor (Brian Cox in a subtly chilling performance). Adapted from the first of Thomas Harris’s Lecktor novels, MANHUNTER’s supporting cast includes Tom Noonan as the hunted killer, and three-time Oscar nominee Joan Allen. “Here, in only his third feature, [Mann] is at his very best.” – Empire Magazine

title: Colony
description: Horror master Yeon Sang-ho’s ( Train to Busan ) new zombie thriller stars Gianna Jun as biology professor Se-jeong, who’s thrust into a bloody nightmare when a rapidly mutating virus is released during a biotech conference causing authorities to seal the facility. Trapped inside with no escape, Se-jeong along with a small group of survivors must fight to stay alive while the infected undergo horrific transformations. Also starring Koo Kyo-hawn.

title: Stop Making Sense
description: Considered by critics as the greatest concert film of all time, STOP MAKING SENSE stars core band members David Byrne, Tina Weymouth, Chris Frantz, and Jerry Harrison along with Bernie Worrell, Alex Weir, Steve Scales, Lynn Mabry and Edna Holt. The live performance was shot over the course of three nights at Hollywood’s Pantages Theater in December of 1983 and features Talking Heads’ most memorable songs.

title: Bully
description: The true story of a group of Florida teenagers who conspired to kill an abusive classmate who used psychological, physical and sexual violence against them. Staff Pick by Chris Hickey, usher

title: Dead Ringers
description: Twin gynecologists take full advantage of the fact that nobody can tell them apart, until their relationship begins to deteriorate over a woman.

title: The Crow
description: People once believed that when someone dies, a crow carries their soul to the land of the dead. But sometimes, just sometimes, the crow can bring that soul back to put the wrong things right. The big screen goth fantasy update of James O’Barr’s comic follows a murdered musician resurrected to avenge his death and the killing of his fiancé. Featuring a soulful performance by the late Brandon Lee, stellar, rain-slicked cinematography by Dariusz Wolski, and a propulsive, chart-topping soundtrack featuring songs by The Cure, The Jesus and Mary Chain, Rage Against the Machine, Nine Inch Nails, Stone Temple Pilots, and more.

title: Steel
description: The construction of a steel skyscraper becomes a race against time and challenges the sanity of a building foreman and his crew.

title: The Maltese Falcon             / The Petrified Forest
description: Everyone’s looking for it and they’ll do anything to get it! The Maltese Falcon , that is. It’s not just the opulent treasure in the mind’s eye of every San Francisco low-life, it’s also one of the first shining examples of Hollywood noir, a stunningly confident directing debut for John Huston, and a sordid melodrama which transformed Humphrey Bogart from B-movie sideman to star romantic lead. Mary Astor co-stars as the hot-blooded but inscrutable femme fatale who drags hard-boiled private eye Sam Spade (Bogart) into the hunt for the Falcon. Peter Lorre and Sydney Greenstreet (in his Academy Award-nominated film debut!) round out the conspiratorial cast as dandy-gangsters with twisted loyalties. The paradigm for film noir to come, this loaded, sordid mystery gets right to the tragic truth about love and crime: “It’s the stuff that dreams are made of.”

title: Live and Let Die
description: James Bond is sent to stop a diabolically brilliant heroin magnate armed with a complex organization and a reliable tarot reader.

title: Fighting Spirit: SUNDAY SHORT FILMS
description: Sunday Short Films Part 1 & Part 2 (18) 3h 4m + 10m interval | Multinational | 2025 & 2026 Various directors Multiple languages with English subtitles  This event will feature a short martial arts demonstration during the interval of the following short films.  Way of War (13m) (USA) Story of the Dr...

title: Late Fame
description: The great Willem Dafoe lends his delicate gravitas to the role of Ed Saxberger, a forgotten New York poet who works in the post office. After an eager and flattering young admirer (Edmund Donovan) appears on his doorstep, Saxberger is beckoned into a coterie of twenty-something admirers who anoint him as a rediscovered genius. Intoxicated by the attention — and by the alluring presence of Gloria, the group’s“ tragic heroine” (a sinuous, Kurt Weill– crooning Greta Lee) — Saxberger gradually reckons with the authenticity of his newfound poetic circle. This thoughtful, witty second feature from Kent Jones (DIANE), working from a sly and hugely entertaining script by Oscar - nominated screenwriter Samy Burch (MAYDECEMBER), is a wistful yet unromantic look at a lost idea of downtown New York.

title: Teenage Sex and Death at Camp Miasma
description: The infamous Camp Miasma slasher franchise is getting rebooted yet again. But when the latest movie’s director becomes obsessed with the mysterious, reclusive actress who played the “final girl” in the original film, a whole new kind of slasher emerges from the bottom of the lake. Warning: This film contains sequences with flashing or flickering lights that may affect individuals with photosensitivity. Viewer discretion is advised.

title: How to Divorce During the War
Members' Screening: Bitter Christmas (15)
description: Pedro Almodóvar is back with his unique brand of storytelling, setting the stage for the tale of a filmmaker who is a little too heavily inspired by the real lives of those around him.

title: Rio
description: This comedy-adventure centers on Blu, a flightless rare macaw who acts more human than bird. His world is turned upside down…

title: The Room with Tommy Wiseau live on stage
description: PLEASE NOTE - TOMMY WISEAU WILL BE TAKING TO THE STAGE AT THE FILMS ADVERTISED TIME! Please arrive 30 mins early to collect your ticket, take your seat, grab merch and meet Tommy before the film starts! Yes we know the shows are allocated seating, but if you all arrive at the advertised time we end up with a very busy foyer / bar & you won't get to your seat when the q&a starts! ----------------------------- Tommy Wiseau returns to The Prince Charles Cinema, live and in person, in Septmeber 2026 to once again answer your questions, pose for photos*, sign autographs** and introduce a host of screenings of the 2003 "masterpiece", THE ROOM! So what are you waiting for? Get your handful of PLASTIC spoons***, your tuxedos at the ready and prepare to take part in the most "unique" cinematic experience on the planet... Tommy Wiseau's, THE ROOM! * - Tommy requests that you purchase some of his merchandise before posing for photographs [he'll have the usual DVDs, BluRays, Posters, Pants, Belts, Dogs... you name it, he's selling it!] ** - Same applies for photo opps as it does for signatures, pick up some merch to put a smile on Tommy's face for your photo together. *** - No Metal Spoons, No Inflatables, No American Footballs!!! If found throwing any of these, they will be confiscated and you will be asked to leave with no refund. Please consider the environment and don't go overboard with plastic spoons.
